entries.definition: The part of clothing that covers the arm.
entries.example: The sleeve of this shirt is too long.

entries.meaning: kéo giãn, kéo căng
entries.definition: To pull something so that it becomes longer.
entries.example: Stretch your arms before you begin the exercise.

entries.meaning: hợp với ai/hoàn cảnh · phù hợp ~ vừa kích cỡ ~ hợp nhau về màu/kiểu
entries.definition: To look good on someone; appropriate; the right size; to look good together.
entries.note: suit nghĩa là hợp với người/hoàn cảnh; fit nghĩa là vừa kích cỡ; match nghĩa là hai vật hợp nhau về màu/kiểu.
entries.example: The blue shirt suits Mai, fits her well, and matches her skirt; it is suitable for the event.

entries.meaning: xé
entries.definition: To pull something apart and damage it.
entries.example: Be careful not to tear the paper.

entries.meaning: trưng bày · cuộc/sự triển lãm
entries.definition: To show something publicly; a public display.
entries.example: The museum exhibited student art, and the exhibition was open for a week.

entries.meaning: chuẩn bị cho điều gì · sự chuẩn bị
entries.definition: To get ready for something; the process of getting ready.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: prepare (v) for st · preparation (n)
entries.example: We prepared for the show, and our preparation took two days.

entries.meaning: cảm thấy thất vọng · gây thất vọng · sự thất vọng
entries.definition: Feeling unhappy about a result; causing disappointment; the feeling itself.
entries.example: I was disappointed because the disappointing result caused great disappointment.

entries.meaning: tham gia, liên quan vào việc gì
entries.definition: Taking part in or connected with something.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: be involved in st
entries.example: Many students were involved in designing the school poster.

entries.meaning: giải thích điều gì cho ai · lời/sự giải thích
entries.definition: To make something clear to someone; information that makes it clear.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: explain (v) st to sb · explanation (n)
entries.example: The teacher explained the task to us, and her explanation was clear.

entries.meaning: bỏ ra, tháo ra, loại bỏ cái gì khỏi…
entries.definition: To take something away from a place.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: remove (v) st from…
entries.example: Please remove the old label from the box.

entries.meaning: miêu tả điều gì là… · lời/sự miêu tả
entries.definition: To say what something is like; a written or spoken account.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: describe (v) st as… · description (n)
entries.example: The guide described the building as ancient, and her description was easy to understand.

entries.meaning: quen thuộc với ai/cái gì
entries.definition: Knowing someone or something well because of previous experience.
entries.note: familiar with + người hoặc sự vật.
entries.example: Students should become familiar with the tools and the people in their research group.

entries.meaning: tưởng tượng · trí tưởng tượng · giàu trí tưởng tượng/sáng tạo · chỉ có trong tưởng tượng
entries.definition: To form a picture in the mind; creative thought; creative; existing only in the mind.
entries.note: imaginative nghĩa là giàu trí tưởng tượng/sáng tạo; imaginary nghĩa là chỉ tồn tại trong tưởng tượng, không có thật.
entries.example: Imagine an imaginary city; use your imagination to create an imaginative picture.

entries.meaning: sáng tác/soạn · nhà soạn nhạc · tác phẩm/bài sáng tác
entries.definition: To create music or writing; a music writer; a created work.
entries.example: The composer composed a short song, and the composition was played at school.

entries.meaning: bỏ sót, bỏ quên
entries.definition: To fail to include something.
entries.example: Do not leave out your name when you complete the form.

entries.meaning: - trang trí · - kéo khóa/kéo séc/đóng cúc…
entries.definition: To decorate or repair; to fasten clothing.
entries.example: Please do up your coat because it is cold.

entries.meaning: mặc/đeo vào >< cởi/tháo ra
entries.definition: To dress in; to remove clothing.
entries.note: put on nghĩa là mặc/đeo vào; take off nghĩa là cởi/tháo ra.
entries.example: Put on the jacket before you go out, and take it off when you come inside.

entries.meaning: mặc thử
entries.definition: To put on clothing to check its size or appearance.
entries.example: Try on the shoes before you buy them.

entries.meaning: đã tuyệt chủng · sự tuyệt chủng
entries.definition: No longer existing; the complete disappearance of a species.
entries.example: Dinosaurs are extinct, and their extinction happened millions of years ago.

entries.meaning: dự báo/bản dự báo · dự báo thời tiết
entries.definition: To predict; a statement about future weather.
entries.example: Experts forecast rain, and the weather forecast is shown on TV.

entries.meaning: đợt nóng bất thường
entries.definition: A period of unusually hot weather.
entries.example: The city opened cool rooms during the heatwave.

entries.meaning: côn trùng # động vật có vú # bò sát # động vật lưỡng cư
entries.definition: Four distinct animal groups: insects, mammals, reptiles, and amphibians.
entries.note: Đây là bốn nhóm động vật khác nhau.
entries.example: A butterfly is an insect, a whale is a mammal, a snake is a reptile, and a frog is an amphibian.

entries.meaning: sét/chớp # sấm
entries.definition: A bright electrical flash in a storm; the sound caused by that electrical activity.
entries.note: lightning là ánh chớp/sét; thunder là tiếng sấm.
entries.example: We saw lightning before we heard thunder.

entries.meaning: vứt rác/rác bị vứt bừa bãi ~ rác nói chung
entries.definition: Rubbish left in a public place.
entries.note: litter là rác bị vứt bừa bãi và còn là động từ; rubbish phổ biến ở Anh–Anh; trash/garbage phổ biến ở Anh–Mỹ.
entries.example: Please put litter, rubbish, trash, and garbage in the correct bin.

entries.spoken: locate · location · be located or situated in or at…
entries.ipa: /ˈloʊˌkeɪt loʊˈkeɪʃən biː ˈloʊˌkeɪtəd ɔːr ˈsɪtʃuˌeɪtɪd ɪn ɔːr æt/
entries.meaning: xác định/đặt vị trí · vị trí/địa điểm · tọa lạc ở…
entries.definition: To find or place; a position; situated in a place.
entries.example: The school is located near the park, and its location is easy to find; it is situated beside the library.

entries.meaning: bảo tồn/giữ gìn · sự bảo tồn
entries.definition: To protect something from damage; the act of protecting.
entries.example: The museum preserves old books, and their preservation protects local history.

entries.meaning: vệ tinh nhân tạo
entries.definition: An object sent into space to collect or transmit information.
entries.example: The satellite sends weather pictures back to Earth.

entries.meaning: loài · loài động vật · loài có nguy cơ tuyệt chủng
entries.definition: A group of similar living things; species at risk of extinction.
entries.example: The tiger is an endangered species, and every animal species needs a safe home.

entries.meaning: giải cứu · sự/cuộc giải cứu
entries.definition: To save someone or something from danger; an act of saving someone or something.
entries.note: rescue dùng được như động từ và danh từ.
entries.example: The team rescued the bird during a difficult rescue operation.

entries.meaning: xâm lược/xâm chiếm · kẻ xâm lược · cuộc xâm lược
entries.definition: To enter and take control; a person or thing that invades; the act of invading.
entries.example: Ants invaded the kitchen; the invaders caused an invasion that was hard to stop.

entries.meaning: làm ô nhiễm môi trường ~ làm bẩn/làm mất an toàn một chất · sự ô nhiễm ~ sự nhiễm bẩn · chất gây ô nhiễm
entries.definition: To make air, water, or land dirty; pollution; a substance that pollutes.
entries.note: pollute thường nói về môi trường; contaminate là làm một chất/vật trở nên bẩn hoặc không an toàn.
entries.example: Factories can pollute and contaminate rivers; this pollution and contamination come from harmful pollutants.

entries.term: be aware of st · awareness · raise awareness about st
entries.sourceTerm: be aware of st · awareness (n) · raise awareness about st
entries.spoken: be aware of something · awareness · raise awareness about something
entries.ipa: /biː əˈwɛr ʌv ˈsʌmθɪŋ əˈwɛrnəs reɪz əˈwɛrnəs əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
entries.meaning: nhận thức được điều gì · sự nhận thức · nâng cao nhận thức về điều gì
entries.definition: Knowing about something; knowledge and understanding.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: be aware of st · awareness (n) · raise awareness about st
entries.example: Students should be aware of plastic waste, build awareness, and raise awareness about recycling.

entries.meaning: nhiệt tình/hào hứng · sự nhiệt tình/hào hứng
entries.definition: Showing strong interest; strong interest and energy.
entries.example: The students were enthusiastic, and their enthusiasm made the project enjoyable.

entries.meaning: thiếu điều gì · sự thiếu hụt
entries.definition: Not having enough; an insufficient amount.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: short (a) of st · shortage (n)
entries.example: The town is short of clean water, and the shortage affects many families.

entries.meaning: ngăn cản ai đó làm gì
entries.definition: To stop someone from doing something.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: prevent (v) sb from doing st
entries.example: A strong fence prevents animals from entering the road.

entries.meaning: trốn thoát khỏi…
entries.definition: To get away from a place or danger.
entries.example: The bird escaped from its cage.

entries.meaning: - nghiêm trọng · - nghiêm túc
entries.definition: Severe or important; thoughtful and not joking.
entries.example: The storm caused serious damage to several homes.

entries.meaning: nổ tung
entries.definition: To explode.
entries.example: Workers blew up the old bridge after closing the road.

entries.meaning: dập tắt (lửa)
entries.definition: To extinguish a fire.
entries.example: Firefighters put out the fire quickly.

entries.meaning: (lửa, nến, đèn…) tắt
entries.definition: To stop burning or producing light.
entries.example: The candle went out when the wind entered the room.

entries.meaning: làm khó chịu · gây khó chịu · cảm thấy khó chịu · sự khó chịu
entries.definition: To make someone slightly angry; causing annoyance; feeling annoyed; the feeling.
entries.example: The loud noise annoyed Mai; it was annoying, and her annoyed look showed her annoyance.

entries.meaning: thái độ
entries.definition: A way of thinking or feeling about something.
entries.example: A positive attitude can help students learn from mistakes.

entries.meaning: nóng tính, hay cáu gắt
entries.definition: Easily annoyed or angry.
entries.example: The bad-tempered man became angry over a small problem.

entries.meaning: cư xử · cư xử sai · hành vi/cách cư xử · hành vi sai trái
entries.definition: To act in a particular way; to behave badly; conduct.
entries.example: The children behaved well, but one boy misbehaved; the teacher discussed his behavior and misbehavior.

entries.meaning: sợ điều gì
entries.definition: Afraid of something.
entries.note: frightened of và scared of cùng nghĩa; scared tự nhiên hơn trong giao tiếp.
entries.example: My little sister is frightened of, or scared of, large dogs.

entries.meaning: làm buồn/suy sụp · gây buồn/chán · cảm thấy buồn/suy sụp · sự trầm cảm/suy sụp
entries.definition: To make someone very unhappy; causing sadness; very unhappy; serious sadness.
entries.example: Long periods of sadness can depress people; a depressing situation may make someone feel depressed and can lead to depression.

entries.meaning: khốn khổ/đau buồn · sự khốn khổ
entries.definition: Extremely unhappy; great unhappiness.
entries.example: He felt miserable after losing his pet, and his misery was clear to everyone.

entries.meaning: nghịch ngợm
entries.definition: Behaving badly, especially as a child.
entries.example: The naughty child drew on the classroom wall.

entries.spoken: react to somebody or something · reaction
entries.meaning: phản ứng với ai/điều gì · phản ứng
entries.definition: To respond to something; a response.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: react (v) to sb/st · reaction (n)
entries.example: Mai reacted calmly to the news, and her reaction helped the group stay calm.

entries.meaning: nực cười, lố bịch
entries.definition: Very unreasonable or silly.
entries.example: It is ridiculous to believe every message you see online.

entries.meaning: buồn, thất vọng · buồn
entries.definition: Unhappy or worried.
entries.note: sad chỉ buồn; upset rộng hơn, có thể buồn/lo/bực và thường là phản ứng tạm thời.
entries.example: Lan was upset and sad because her friend had moved away.

entries.meaning: đôi khi · thỉnh thoảng
entries.definition: Sometimes.
entries.note: at times và sometimes cùng nghĩa; at times trang trọng hơn một chút.
entries.example: At times, or sometimes, everyone needs a quiet place to think.

entries.meaning: hài kịch >< bi kịch
entries.definition: A funny play or film; a very sad play or event.
entries.note: Chú ý cặp đối lập hoặc điểm khác nhau được đánh dấu trong danh sách. Cách kết hợp: comedy (n) >< tragedy (n)
entries.example: A comedy usually makes people laugh, while a tragedy often makes them feel sad.

entries.meaning: sự cảm thông · cảm thông · biết cảm thông
entries.definition: Understanding another person's feelings; to show understanding; understanding and kind.
entries.example: I felt sympathy for Hoa, sympathized with her situation, and sent her a sympathetic message.

entries.meaning: lòng căm ghét · căm ghét
entries.definition: A very strong feeling of dislike; to dislike strongly.
entries.example: Hatred can harm people, so we should not hate someone simply because we disagree.

entries.meaning: làm ai ngượng/ngại · gây ngượng · cảm thấy ngượng · sự ngượng ngùng
entries.definition: To make someone feel socially uncomfortable; causing that feeling; feeling self-conscious; the feeling itself.
entries.note: embarrassed là ngượng/ngại trong tình huống xã hội; ashamed là xấu hổ hoặc có lỗi về việc mình đã làm.
entries.example: Forgetting her name embarrassed him; the moment was embarrassing, he felt embarrassed, and his embarrassment was obvious.

entries.spoken: ashamed of ~ embarrassed about or by
entries.meaning: xấu hổ/có lỗi về việc mình làm ~ ngượng vì tình huống xã hội
entries.definition: Feeling guilty or embarrassed about something.
entries.note: ashamed of nghĩa là xấu hổ/có lỗi về việc mình làm; embarrassed about/by nghĩa là ngượng vì tình huống xã hội. Không dùng embarrassed of.
entries.example: She was ashamed of her unkind words and embarrassed by her behavior.

entries.meaning: lo lắng về…
entries.definition: Worried or anxious about something.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: nervous (a) about st
entries.example: Many students feel nervous about speaking in front of the class.

entries.term: frighten ~ scare · frightening · frightened of st
entries.sourceTerm: frighten (v) ~ scare (v) · frightening (a) · frightened (a) of st
entries.spoken: frighten ~ scare · frightening · frightened of something
entries.meaning: làm sợ · gây sợ · cảm thấy sợ điều gì
entries.definition: To make someone afraid; causing fear; feeling afraid.
entries.note: scare thông dụng hơn; frighten trang trọng hơn. frightening gây sợ, frightened là cảm thấy sợ.
entries.example: The sudden sound frightened, or scared, us; it was frightening, and we were frightened of hearing it again.

entries.meaning: nhân vật/tính cách · đặc điểm tiêu biểu
entries.definition: A person in a story or a person's nature; a typical quality.
entries.note: character nghĩa là nhân vật hoặc tính cách; characteristic nghĩa là đặc điểm tiêu biểu.
entries.example: Patience is an important character trait and a useful characteristic for a teacher.

entries.meaning: bắt nạt · kẻ bắt nạt
entries.definition: To repeatedly hurt or frighten; a person who bullies.
entries.note: Học theo nhóm từ/cụm và phân biệt đúng từ loại. Cách kết hợp: bully (v) · (n)
entries.example: The school stopped a bully who had repeatedly hurt younger students.

entries.meaning: ăn mừng, tổ chức
entries.definition: To mark a happy event with an activity.
entries.example: Our class will celebrate its success with a small party.

entries.meaning: chúc mừng ai đó vì …
entries.definition: To tell someone you are pleased about their success.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: congratulate (v) sb on st
entries.example: The teacher congratulated Minh on winning the writing contest.

entries.meaning: nói to lên
entries.definition: To speak more loudly.
entries.example: Please speak up so everyone at the back can hear you.

entries.meaning: chờ một chút · chờ
entries.definition: To wait for a short time.
entries.note: hang on là cách nói thân mật để bảo ai chờ một lát; wait là từ trung tính.
entries.example: Hang on, or wait, for a moment while I find the page.

entries.meaning: bình tĩnh lại
entries.definition: To become less angry or worried.
entries.example: Take a slow breath and calm down before you answer.

entries.meaning: cho là đúng khi chưa có bằng chứng ~ cho rằng/giả sử · giả định
entries.definition: To accept something as true without proof; an idea accepted without proof.
entries.note: assume nghĩa là cho là đúng khi chưa có bằng chứng; suppose thường là suy đoán dè dặt hoặc đặt giả thiết.
entries.example: We assume, or suppose, that the bus will arrive on time, but this assumption may be wrong.

entries.meaning: khẳng định/tuyên bố · lời khẳng định; yêu cầu
entries.definition: To say that something is true, or such a statement; to ask formally for something you believe you should receive.
entries.note: claim dùng được như động từ và danh từ.
entries.example: The company claims that the bag lasts ten years, but this claim still needs evidence.

entries.term: complain to sb about st · complaint
entries.sourceTerm: complain (v) to sb about st · complaint (n)
entries.spoken: complain to somebody about something · complaint
entries.meaning: phàn nàn với ai về điều gì · lời/sự phàn nàn
entries.definition: To express dissatisfaction; a statement of dissatisfaction.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: complain (v) to sb about st · complaint (n)
entries.example: Mai complained to the shop about the broken bottle and made a clear complaint.

entries.term: convince sb that… ~ persuade sb to do…
entries.sourceTerm: convince (v) sb that… ~ persuade (v) sb to do…
entries.spoken: convince somebody that… ~ persuade somebody to do…
entries.ipa: /kəˈnvɪns ˈsʌˌmbɑːdi ðæt pɚˈsweɪd ˈsʌˌmbɑːdi tuː duː/
entries.meaning: thuyết phục ai tin rằng… ~ thuyết phục ai làm gì
entries.definition: To make someone believe or agree.
entries.note: convince sb that…: khiến ai tin; persuade sb to do…: thuyết phục ai hành động.
entries.example: The evidence convinced me, and the teacher persuaded the class to check it carefully.

entries.meaning: thảo luận · cuộc/sự thảo luận
entries.definition: To talk about a subject; a conversation about it.
entries.example: The group discussed the problem, and the discussion produced two simple ideas.

entries.meaning: chỉ trích · mang tính phê bình/chỉ trích · sự/lời chỉ trích
entries.definition: To express disapproval; judging carefully; an unfavourable comment.
entries.example: The teacher criticized the unclear answer; her critical comment was fair, and the criticism helped me improve it.

entries.meaning: ca ngợi · lời khen; sự ca ngợi
entries.definition: To express approval or admiration; words that express approval or admiration.
entries.note: praise dùng được như động từ và danh từ.
entries.example: The teacher praised Lan for her careful work, and the praise encouraged her to continue.

entries.meaning: nghi ngờ
entries.definition: To feel uncertain about something; uncertainty.
entries.example: I doubt that the plan will work without more time.

entries.term: encourage sb to do st · encouragement >< discourage sb from doing st
entries.sourceTerm: encourage (v) sb to do st · encouragement (n) >< discourage (v) sb from doing st
entries.spoken: encourage somebody to do something · encouragement >< discourage somebody from doing something
entries.ipa: /ɛˈnkɝːɪdʒ ˈsʌˌmbɑːdi tuː duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɛˈnkɝːɪdʒmənt dɪˈskɝːɪdʒ ˈsʌˌmbɑːdi frʌm ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
entries.meaning: khuyến khích ai làm gì · sự khuyến khích >< ngăn/nản ai làm gì
entries.definition: To give support and confidence; support; to reduce confidence.
entries.note: encourage sb to do; discourage sb from doing. Hai động từ dùng hai giới từ/cấu trúc khác nhau.
entries.example: The coach encouraged us to keep trying, and his encouragement helped; he discouraged us from giving up.

entries.meaning: thoát khỏi, vứt bỏ…
entries.definition: To remove or throw away something unwanted.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: get rid of st
entries.example: The town wants to get rid of plastic waste by using fewer bags.

entries.meaning: lí tưởng
entries.definition: Perfect or most suitable.
entries.example: An ideal study plan is clear, practical, and easy to follow.

entries.meaning: điều tra/nghiên cứu · cuộc/sự điều tra
entries.definition: To examine facts carefully; a careful official examination.
entries.example: The school investigated the missing books, and the investigation found them in another room.

entries.meaning: tích cực >< tiêu cực
entries.definition: Helpful or confident; harmful or unfavourable.
entries.note: Chú ý cặp đối lập hoặc điểm khác nhau được đánh dấu trong danh sách. Cách kết hợp: positive (a) >< negative (a)
entries.example: The plan has both positive and negative effects.

entries.meaning: giả vờ
entries.definition: To behave as if something is true when it is not.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: pretend (v) to do st
entries.example: He pretended to understand the task instead of asking for help.

entries.meaning: từ chối làm gì · sự/lời từ chối
entries.definition: To say that you will not do something; an act of refusing.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: refuse (v) to do st · refusal (n)
entries.example: The shop refused to replace the bag, and its refusal disappointed the customer.

entries.meaning: phủ nhận đã làm gì
entries.definition: To say that you did not do something.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: deny (v) doing st
entries.example: The student denied copying the answer and asked the teacher to check her work.

entries.meaning: lời đồn; tin đồn
entries.definition: Unconfirmed information passed from one person to another that may not be true.
entries.note: rumour là danh từ; động từ tương ứng thường dùng spread a rumour.
entries.example: A false rumour spread quickly through the class group, although nobody could confirm it.

entries.meaning: lí thuyết >< việc áp dụng thực tế · thuộc lí thuyết
entries.definition: An explanation of ideas; actual use or action; based on ideas rather than action.
entries.note: theory nghĩa là hệ thống ý tưởng/lí thuyết; practice nghĩa là việc áp dụng thực tế; theoretical là tính từ.
entries.example: The theory sounds reasonable, but we need to test it in practice; the theoretical idea may work differently in real life.

entries.meaning: khuyên · lời khuyên
entries.definition: To recommend an action; a recommendation.
entries.example: Teachers advise students to plan their time and ask for advice when necessary.

entries.meaning: áp lực/sức ép · đang chịu áp lực
entries.definition: Stress caused by demands; in a stressful situation.
entries.example: People often make poor decisions when they are under pressure.

entries.meaning: tình trạng/đống lộn xộn · lộn xộn/bừa bộn · đang trong tình trạng lộn xộn
entries.definition: A dirty or untidy state; untidy.
entries.example: The room was in a mess because messy papers were left everywhere.

entries.term: in my view ~ in my opinion # in trouble
entries.sourceTerm: in my view ~ in my opinion # in trouble
entries.spoken: in my view ~ in my opinion # in trouble
entries.ipa: /ɪn maɪ vjuː ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən ɪn ˈtrʌbəl/
entries.meaning: theo quan điểm của tôi # đang gặp rắc rối
entries.definition: From my point of view; in a difficult situation.
entries.note: in my view và in my opinion cùng nêu quan điểm. in trouble là cụm riêng, nghĩa là đang gặp rắc rối.
entries.example: In my view, or in my opinion, the team is in trouble because it has too little time.

entries.meaning: ngoại trừ · ngoại lệ · đặc biệt/xuất sắc
entries.definition: Not including; something that does not follow the rule; unusually excellent.
entries.example: Everyone except Nam agreed; his choice was the only exception, but his work was exceptional.

entries.meaning: sở thích, khuynh hướng (thích cái gì hơn)
entries.definition: A greater liking for one option.
entries.example: The survey records students' preferences for different learning activities.

entries.term: approve of st ~ agree with st >< disapprove of st · approval >< disapproval
entries.sourceTerm: approve (v) of st ~ agree with st >< disapprove (v) of st · approval (n) >< disapproval (n)
entries.spoken: approve of something ~ agree with something >< disapprove of something · approval >< disapproval
entries.ipa: /əˈpruːv ʌv ˈsʌmθɪŋ əˈɡriː wɪð ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˌdɪsəˈpruːv ʌv ˈsʌmθɪŋ əˈpruːvəl dɪsəˈpruːvəl/
entries.meaning: tán thành/cho là tốt ~ đồng ý/cùng ý kiến >< không tán thành · sự tán thành >< sự không tán thành
entries.definition: To agree with; to disagree with; agreement or disagreement.
entries.note: approve of nghĩa là cho là tốt/ủng hộ; agree with nghĩa là cùng ý kiến với; disapprove of nghĩa là không tán thành.
entries.example: Most parents approve of and agree with the change, while a few disapprove of it; the plan received more approval than disapproval.

entries.meaning: khăng khăng làm gì
entries.definition: To demand something firmly.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: insist (v) on doing st
entries.example: She insisted on checking every number before sending the report.

entries.meaning: đề xuất/gợi ý · lời đề xuất/gợi ý
entries.definition: To advise a suitable action; an advised action.
entries.note: recommend và suggest đều đi với danh từ, V-ing hoặc that-clause; không dùng suggest sb to do.
entries.example: The teacher recommended, or suggested, a simpler plan; her recommendation and suggestion helped the class.

entries.meaning: cạn kiệt cái gì
entries.definition: To use all of something so none remains.
entries.note: Dùng đúng cấu trúc kết hợp của từ; sb là viết tắt của somebody, st là viết tắt của something. Cách kết hợp: run out of st
entries.example: The village ran out of clean water during the long dry period.

entries.term: work out ~ figure out # sort out # find out
entries.sourceTerm: work out ~ figure out # sort out # find out
entries.spoken: work out ~ figure out # sort out # find out
entries.ipa: /wɝːk aʊt ˈfɪɡjɚ aʊt sɔːrt aʊt faɪnd aʊt/
entries.meaning: tìm ra lời giải/hiểu ra # xử lí/sắp xếp ổn thỏa # phát hiện thông tin
entries.definition: To find a solution or understand the answer.
entries.note: work out/figure out nghĩa là tìm ra cách hiểu/giải; sort out nghĩa là sắp xếp hoặc xử lí ổn thỏa; find out nghĩa là khám phá thông tin.
entries.example: After several tests, the team worked out, sorted out, and figured out the problem; it then found out who could fix it.

entries.meaning: hành trình dài, nhất là bằng đường biển ~ chuyến đi, thường có đi rồi về ~ hành trình từ nơi này đến nơi khác
entries.definition: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea; a trip is a visit or journey in general, while journey emphasizes travelling from one place to another.
entries.note: voyage chủ yếu là hành trình dài bằng đường biển; trip là chuyến đi nói chung, còn journey nhấn mạnh quá trình di chuyển.
entries.example: The six-week voyage was a much longer journey than their usual weekend trips.

entries.meaning: chuyến đi tham quan
entries.definition: A short organized trip made for pleasure, education, or a particular purpose.
entries.note: excursion là chuyến đi ngắn có tổ chức, thường để tham quan hoặc học tập.
entries.example: During the school excursion, students visited a coastal museum and interviewed a local guide.

entries.meaning: cảnh hoặc điều nhìn thấy ~ quang cảnh nhìn từ một vị trí ~ phong cảnh thiên nhiên nói chung
entries.definition: A sight is something seen; a view is what can be seen from a particular place, while scenery is the general natural landscape.
entries.note: sight là cảnh/cảnh tượng cụ thể; view là tầm nhìn từ một vị trí; scenery là phong cảnh chung, không đếm được.
entries.example: The waterfall was an unforgettable sight, and the viewpoint offered a wide view of the surrounding scenery.

entries.meaning: lãnh thổ
entries.definition: An area of land controlled by a country, government, or group.
entries.example: The treaty defines the territory controlled by each country and protects the shared border.

entries.meaning: cước/phí đi lại # phạt; tiền phạt # khoản phí phải trả ~ khoản tiền được tính # vé
entries.definition: Fare is the cost of a journey; a fine is a financial penalty; a fee or charge is money paid for a service; a ticket gives the right to travel or enter.
entries.note: fare là tiền đi tàu xe; fine là tiền phạt; fee/charge là khoản phí dịch vụ; ticket là vé.
entries.example: The train fare was $20, but he also paid a fine for travelling without a valid ticket; the booking fee was separate.

entries.spoken: arrive in or at + place , reach + place
entries.meaning: đến một địa điểm, dùng in/at trước địa điểm ~ đến hoặc đặt chân tới một địa điểm, không dùng in/at
entries.definition: Arrive in/at and reach both mean to get to a place, but reach takes no preposition.
entries.note: arrive at + địa điểm nhỏ, arrive in + thành phố/quốc gia; reach + địa điểm, không có at/in.
entries.example: We arrived at the station at noon and reached the hotel before the heavy rain began.

entries.meaning: biên giới, ranh giới
entries.definition: The official line separating two countries or areas; also the edge of something.
entries.example: Officers checked every vehicle before it crossed the international border.

entries.type: verb · noun · phrase / pattern · word family
entries.meaning: tiến về một địa điểm · tiến bộ, phát triển; sự tiến bộ
entries.definition: To move forward towards a place; as a noun or general verb, advance also means progress or improvement.
entries.note: advance to/towards là tiến về phía trước; an advance còn có thể là khoản trả trước hoặc một bước tiến.
entries.example: The rescue team advanced towards the village as weather conditions improved.

entries.meaning: nhận ra, công nhận · sự nhận ra, sự công nhận
entries.definition: To identify somebody or something from previous knowledge, or to formally accept its status or value.
entries.example: I recognized the building from the photograph, and its official recognition as a historic site followed later.

entries.meaning: rộng · làm rộng, mở rộng · chiều rộng, phạm vi rộng
entries.definition: Broad means wide or covering many subjects; broaden means to make wider; breadth is the noun.
entries.example: The university broadened the course to cover a broad range of topics in greater breadth.

entries.meaning: cư dân, người sinh sống tại một nơi
entries.definition: A person who lives in a particular place.
entries.note: resident nhấn mạnh nơi cư trú; inhabitant là người/sinh vật sống ở một nơi; dweller thường đi trong từ ghép như city dweller.
entries.example: Many residents work in the city, while long-term inhabitants still describe themselves as village dwellers.

entries.meaning: đi về phía, hướng tới
entries.definition: To move or travel in the direction of a place.
entries.example: After checking the map, the cyclists headed for the coast and made for the nearest campsite.

entries.term: drop sb off >< pick sb up
entries.spoken: drop somebody off , pick somebody up
entries.meaning: đưa ai đến rồi cho xuống xe · đón ai lên xe
entries.definition: To drop somebody off is to take them somewhere and let them out of a vehicle; to pick somebody up is to collect them.
entries.note: drop sb off là chở ai đến rồi cho xuống; trái nghĩa tự nhiên trong ngữ cảnh xe cộ là pick sb up.
entries.example: The driver dropped the passengers off at the terminal and picked them up there that evening.

entries.meaning: tiễn ai đó
entries.definition: To go with somebody to their departure point and say goodbye.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: see sb off.
entries.example: Families gathered at the station to see the exchange students off.

entries.meaning: đón ai đó
entries.definition: To collect somebody in a vehicle from an agreed place.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: pick sb up.
entries.example: The coach will pick us up outside the library at half past six.

entries.meaning: phương tiện công cộng đến và dừng lại · người lái xe tấp vào lề và dừng lại
entries.definition: Pull in means that a train or other vehicle arrives and stops; pull over means that a driver moves to the side of the road and stops.
entries.note: pull in dùng khi tàu/xe đến và dừng; pull over là tấp xe vào lề.
entries.example: The train pulled in as a taxi pulled over outside the station.

entries.meaning: khởi hành, bắt đầu chuyến đi
entries.definition: To begin a journey or start doing something with a particular aim.
entries.example: The climbers set off before sunrise and set out to reach the summit by noon.

entries.term: football pitch # racing track # tennis court # golf course # boxing ring # ice rink
entries.spoken: football pitch , racing track , tennis court , golf course , boxing ring , ice rink
entries.ipa: football /ˈfʊˌtbɔːl/ · pitch /pɪtʃ/ · racing /ˈreɪsɪŋ/ · track /træk/ · tennis /ˈtɛnəs/ · court /kɔːrt/ · golf /ɡɑːlf/ · course /kɔːrs/ · boxing /ˈbɑːksɪŋ/ · ring /rɪŋ/ · ice /aɪs/ · rink /rɪŋk/
entries.meaning: sân bóng đá # đường đua # sân quần vợt # sân gôn # võ đài quyền Anh # sân băng
entries.definition: A pitch, track, court, course, ring, or rink is the particular area used for a specific sport.
entries.note: Dùng đúng danh từ địa điểm: pitch (football), track (racing), court (tennis), course (golf), ring (boxing), rink (ice sports).
entries.example: The football match was played on a pitch, while the boxing final took place in a ring.

entries.meaning: người trực tiếp xem một sự kiện hoặc trận đấu · tập thể khán giả hoặc thính giả · người xem truyền hình hoặc đoạn phim
entries.definition: A spectator is present at an event; an audience watches or listens as a group; a viewer watches through a screen.
entries.note: spectator có mặt tại sự kiện; audience là tập thể người nghe/xem trực tiếp; viewer xem qua màn hình.
entries.example: Thousands of spectators watched in the stadium, a television audience followed live, and online viewers saw the replay.

entries.meaning: trọng tài trong quần vợt, bóng chày và một số môn dùng gậy ~ trọng tài trong bóng đá, quyền Anh và nhiều môn khác
entries.definition: An umpire officiates sports such as tennis, cricket, or baseball; a referee controls games such as football or boxing.
entries.note: umpire thường dùng trong tennis, cricket, baseball; referee dùng trong football, boxing và nhiều môn đối kháng.
entries.example: An umpire checked the tennis line call, while a referee controlled the football match.

entries.meaning: trận chung kết · trận tứ kết · trận bán kết · phần kết hoặc tiết mục kết thúc ấn tượng
entries.definition: A final decides a competition winner, with quarter-finals and semi-finals coming earlier; a finale is the last, often most impressive, part of a performance.
entries.note: final là trận/vòng cuối; finale là phần kết ấn tượng của buổi biểu diễn, tác phẩm hoặc chương trình.
entries.example: After winning the semi-final, the team played in the final before the ceremony ended with a musical finale.

entries.meaning: phần cuối, chương cuối (nhạc, kịch…)
entries.definition: The final and often most impressive part of a performance or event.
entries.example: The orchestra returned for a powerful finale that brought the audience to its feet.

entries.term: baseball bat # hockey stick # fishing rod # tennis racket
entries.spoken: baseball bat , hockey stick , fishing rod , tennis racket
entries.ipa: baseball /ˌbeɪˈsbɔːl/ · bat /bæt/ · hockey /ˈhɑːki/ · stick /stɪk/ · fishing /ˈfɪʃɪŋ/ · rod /rɑːd/ · tennis /ˈtɛnəs/ · racket /ˈrækɪt/
entries.meaning: gậy bóng chày # gậy khúc côn cầu # cần câu # vợt quần vợt
entries.definition: A bat, stick, rod, or racket is a different piece of equipment used in its named sport or activity.
entries.note: bat, stick, rod và racket không thay thế cho nhau; mỗi môn dùng một danh từ dụng cụ riêng.
entries.example: She held a tennis racket, not a baseball bat, while her brother carried a fishing rod.

entries.meaning: hòa; trận hòa
entries.definition: A draw or tie is a game that ends with both sides having the same score; both words can also be used as verbs.
entries.note: draw là hòa trong thể thao; tie cũng là hòa, phổ biến trong Anh–Mỹ.
entries.example: The teams drew 2–2, so the match ended in a tie.

entries.meaning: thời gian nghỉ giữa
entries.definition: A short break between two parts of a performance, lesson, or sporting event.
entries.example: Players discussed their strategy during the interval before the second half began.

entries.term: take pleasure in st · gain pleasure from st
entries.spoken: take pleasure in something , gain pleasure from something
entries.meaning: thấy vui thích khi làm hoặc tiếp xúc với điều gì · có được niềm vui từ điều gì
entries.definition: To enjoy or receive satisfaction from something.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: take pleasure in st · gain pleasure from st.
entries.example: Many learners take pleasure in seeing gradual improvement after regular practice.

entries.meaning: thay phiên làm gì
entries.definition: For people to do something one after another in an agreed order.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: take turns to do st.
entries.example: The group members took turns to present their findings to the class.

entries.meaning: khoản tiền được cấp đều đặn để chi tiêu · tiền lương trả cho công việc
entries.definition: An allowance is money regularly provided for expenses; a salary or wage is money paid for work.
entries.note: Trong bài này, allowance là khoản tiền được cấp đều đặn; không dịch máy móc từ allow là “cho phép”. salary thường là lương cố định theo tháng; wage thường tính theo giờ, ngày hoặc lượng công việc.
entries.example: Her monthly allowance covered books, while her weekend wage came from paid work.

entries.term: associate (v) · be associated with ~ be related to
entries.spoken: associate , be associated with , be related to
entries.meaning: liên hệ hoặc liên tưởng điều này với điều khác · có liên quan đến
entries.definition: To connect one person or thing in your mind with another; associated with means related to.
entries.example: Regular exercise is associated with better sleep and is closely related to mental health.

entries.meaning: hầu như, gần như
entries.definition: Almost, or very nearly, though not completely.
entries.note: practically và virtually đều có thể nghĩa là almost; practically còn có nghĩa 'về mặt thực tế'.
entries.example: The hall was practically empty, and virtually everyone had left before the final announcement.

entries.meaning: duy trì, bảo trì hoặc bảo dưỡng · sự duy trì, việc bảo trì hoặc bảo dưỡng
entries.definition: To keep something in good condition or at the same level; maintenance is the work or process involved.
entries.example: Technicians maintain the equipment weekly, and careful maintenance reduces the risk of failure.

entries.meaning: tham gia một cuộc thi · thích hoặc thường xuyên theo đuổi một hoạt động
entries.definition: To enter a competition or regularly enjoy a particular activity.
entries.note: go in for a competition là tham gia một cuộc thi; go in for a sport/hobby là thích hoặc thường xuyên theo đuổi hoạt động đó.
entries.example: Several students went in for the debate competition because they enjoy public speaking.

entries.meaning: không còn thích điều gì nữa
entries.definition: To stop liking or being interested in something.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: go off st.
entries.example: He went off competitive gaming after it began to affect his schoolwork.

entries.meaning: rút lui (cuộc thi…)
entries.definition: To withdraw from an activity, competition, or agreement.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: pull out of st.
entries.example: Two players pulled out of the tournament because of minor injuries.

entries.term: take to st # take up st
entries.spoken: take to something , take up something
entries.meaning: bắt đầu thích hoặc nhanh chóng quen với điều gì · bắt đầu học hoặc theo đuổi một hoạt động
entries.definition: Take to something means begin to like it or do it naturally; take up something means begin learning or regularly doing an activity.
entries.note: take to st là bắt đầu thích/quen với; take up st là bắt đầu học hoặc theo đuổi một hoạt động.
entries.example: She took to swimming immediately after taking it up as a new hobby.

entries.meaning: chịu đựng, chấp nhận điều khó chịu
entries.definition: To accept an unpleasant situation or person without complaining.
entries.example: Athletes should not have to put up with abusive behaviour from spectators.

entries.meaning: nhân tạo, do con người tạo ra # giả hoặc không đúng sự thật
entries.definition: Artificial means made by people rather than natural; false means not true, genuine, or correct.
entries.note: artificial là do con người tạo ra thay cho tự nhiên; false là sai hoặc giả, có ý lừa/không đúng sự thật.
entries.example: The laboratory uses artificial light, but the report rejected the false claim that the results were natural.

entries.meaning: hoạt động bằng điện hoặc thuộc về điện ~ thuộc thiết bị hoặc mạch điện tử
entries.definition: Electric relates to electricity as power; electronic relates to devices and circuits that process information.
entries.note: electric mô tả thứ dùng hoặc tạo điện; electronic mô tả thiết bị dùng mạch/linh kiện điện tử.
entries.example: An electric motor powers the machine, while electronic sensors record its performance.

entries.meaning: trao giải; giải thưởng cho thành tích ~ thưởng; phần thưởng cho công sức hoặc hành động tốt
entries.definition: An award recognizes achievement; a reward is given in return for effort, help, or good behaviour.
entries.note: award gắn với thành tích được công nhận; reward là phần thưởng đáp lại hành động, nỗ lực hoặc thông tin.
entries.example: The scientist received an award for her discovery and a financial reward for solving the technical problem.

entries.term: attempt (v,n) ~ effort (n) · make an attempt ~ make an effort
entries.spoken: attempt , effort , make an attempt , make an effort
entries.meaning: thử hoặc cố làm; một lần thử ~ sự nỗ lực, công sức · thực hiện một lần thử ~ nỗ lực cố gắng
entries.definition: An act of trying to do something difficult; effort is the physical or mental energy used.
entries.note: attempt vừa là động từ vừa là danh từ, chỉ một lần thử hoặc cố làm; effort là danh từ, nhấn mạnh công sức hoặc năng lượng bỏ ra.
entries.example: The first attempt failed, but the research team made a greater effort during the second trial.

entries.term: manage (v) to V ~ succeed (v) in V-ing
entries.spoken: manage to verb , succeed in doing
entries.meaning: xoay xở làm được việc gì · thành công trong việc làm gì
entries.definition: Manage to and succeed in both mean to achieve a difficult result, but they use different verb patterns.
entries.note: manage to V nhấn mạnh làm được việc khó; succeed in V-ing là thành công trong việc làm gì.
entries.example: The engineers managed to repair the device and succeeded in restoring the lost data.

entries.meaning: quan sát · sự quan sát, nhận xét · đài quan sát · tinh ý, giỏi quan sát
entries.definition: To watch or study carefully; the word family includes the act, the place, and the quality of noticing details.
entries.example: Researchers observed the planet from an observatory, and their careful observations depended on an observant team.

entries.meaning: cuộc cách mạng hoặc sự thay đổi lớn · mang tính cách mạng · cách mạng hóa, làm thay đổi hoàn toàn
entries.definition: A major and often sudden change; revolutionary describes it, and revolutionize means to transform something completely.
entries.example: The discovery was revolutionary and may revolutionize the way doctors detect the disease.

entries.term: technique (n) · technical (a) · technician (n) # technology (n) · technological (a) · technologist (n)
entries.spoken: technique , technical , technician , technology , technological , technologist
entries.ipa: technique /tɛˈkniːk/ · technical /ˈtɛknɪkəl/ · technician /tɛˈknɪʃən/ · technology /tɛˈknɑːlədʒi/ · technological /ˌtɛknəˈlɑːdʒɪkəl/ · technologist /ˌtɛˈknɑːlədʒɪst/
entries.meaning: kĩ thuật hoặc phương pháp · thuộc kĩ thuật · kĩ thuật viên # công nghệ · thuộc công nghệ · chuyên gia công nghệ
entries.definition: A technique is a method; technology is practical scientific knowledge. The related people and adjectives have different uses.
entries.note: technique là phương pháp/kĩ năng thực hiện; technology là hệ thống công nghệ. technician thực hành kĩ thuật; technologist nghiên cứu/ứng dụng công nghệ.
entries.example: The technique is easy to learn, but the technology requires a trained technician and specialist knowledge.

entries.meaning: giải thích · lời hoặc sự giải thích · có thể giải thích được · không thể giải thích được
entries.definition: To make something clear; explicable means understandable, while inexplicable means impossible to explain.
entries.example: The sudden change was explicable, but the second result remained inexplicable despite a detailed explanation.

entries.meaning: tâm lí học · nhà tâm lí học
entries.definition: The scientific study of the mind and behaviour; a psychologist is a specialist in this field.
entries.example: A psychologist used principles from psychology to examine how stress affects memory.

entries.meaning: thực hiện, tiến hành
entries.definition: To complete or perform a task, experiment, study, or procedure.
entries.note: conduct/carry out thường đi với research, survey, experiment; perform còn đi với task, operation hoặc biểu diễn.
entries.example: The university conducted the survey, carried out the analysis, and performed the final safety test.

entries.meaning: nảy ra ý tưởng…
entries.definition: To think of and suggest an idea, plan, or solution.
entries.example: The design team came up with a practical solution to reduce energy consumption.

entries.meaning: phát, thải hoặc tỏa ra
entries.definition: To send out a gas, smell, heat, light, or other substance.
entries.note: emit trang trọng/khoa học hơn; give off thường dùng cho mùi, nhiệt, ánh sáng; release nhấn mạnh việc cho thoát ra.
entries.example: The material gives off a strong smell and may release harmful gases when heated.

entries.term: work out ~ figure out # find out # sort out
entries.spoken: work out , figure out , find out , sort out
entries.meaning: tìm ra cách giải hoặc hiểu ra ~ tìm được cách giải quyết # phát hiện thông tin # sắp xếp hoặc giải quyết ổn thỏa
entries.definition: To discover, understand, or solve something through thought or investigation.
entries.note: work out/figure out là tìm cách hiểu/giải; find out là phát hiện thông tin; sort out là xử lí, sắp xếp cho ổn.
entries.example: After working out the calculation, the students figured out why the original answer was incorrect.

entries.meaning: thu hẹp (sự lựa chọn…)
entries.definition: To reduce a number of choices or possibilities.
entries.example: The evidence helped investigators narrow down the possible causes from ten to three.

entries.meaning: thành công, diễn ra như mong đợi
entries.definition: To happen successfully or produce the intended result.
entries.example: The experiment came off successfully because every stage had been carefully planned.

entries.meaning: tiêu đề lớn của bài báo hoặc bản tin ~ tiêu đề hoặc đề mục của văn bản nói chung
entries.definition: A headline is the title of a news story; a heading labels a section of any text.
entries.note: headline là tiêu đề tin/bài báo; heading là tiêu đề của một phần trong văn bản.
entries.example: The dramatic headline attracted attention, while the heading clearly identified the report section.

entries.meaning: bài báo, bài viết
entries.definition: A piece of writing published in a newspaper, magazine, journal, or website.
entries.example: The article examines how social media influences young people's reading habits.

entries.meaning: báo khổ nhỏ, thường thiên về tin giật gân # báo khổ rộng, thường nghiêm túc và chính thống
entries.definition: A tabloid is smaller and often more sensational; a broadsheet is larger and traditionally more serious.
entries.note: tabloid thường ngắn, giật gân; broadsheet thường dài, trang trọng và thiên về phân tích.
entries.example: A tabloid may favour sensational stories, whereas a broadsheet usually provides more detailed analysis.

entries.meaning: người dẫn hoặc đọc thông báo trên phát thanh, truyền hình # bình luận viên
entries.definition: An announcer presents information; a commentator explains and gives opinions during an event.
entries.note: announcer giới thiệu/đọc thông tin; commentator phân tích và bình luận diễn biến.
entries.example: The announcer introduced the programme, and the commentator then analysed the match.

entries.meaning: bản tin ngắn hoặc thông báo chính thức ~ tin nóng ngắn được phát đột xuất
entries.definition: A bulletin is a short official news report; a newsflash is an urgent report about a recent event.
entries.note: bulletin là bản tin ngắn định kì; newsflash là tin khẩn rất ngắn chen vào chương trình.
entries.example: The station issued a short bulletin, followed minutes later by a newsflash about the earthquake.

entries.meaning: báo chí, giới truyền thông · cuộc họp báo
entries.definition: Newspapers and news organizations as a group; a press conference is a meeting where reporters ask questions.
entries.example: The press questioned officials during a press conference about the delayed response.

entries.term: take st for granted # take st as read
entries.spoken: take something for granted , take something as read
entries.meaning: coi điều gì là hiển nhiên nên không trân trọng · mặc nhiên coi điều gì là đúng hoặc đã được chấp nhận
entries.definition: To take something for granted is to assume it will always be available and often fail to appreciate it; to take something as read is to accept it as already known or true.
entries.note: take st for granted có thể là coi điều gì hiển nhiên hoặc không trân trọng; take st as read là coi như đã biết/được chấp nhận.
entries.example: Do not take reliable internet access for granted; in this report, we can take the basic safety rules as read.

entries.meaning: thay cho, thay vì
entries.definition: As a replacement for somebody or something else.
entries.example: The editor used a verified photograph in place of an image taken from social media.

entries.meaning: do, bởi vì, xét đến
entries.definition: Because of, or after considering, a particular fact.
entries.example: In view of the new evidence, the newspaper corrected its earlier report.

entries.spoken: correspond with somebody or something , correspondence
entries.type: verb · noun · phrase / pattern · word family
entries.meaning: trao đổi thư từ với ai; tương ứng với điều gì · sự trao đổi thư từ; sự tương ứng
entries.definition: To exchange letters or messages with somebody, or to match and be similar to something.
entries.note: correspond with sb là trao đổi thư từ; correspond to/with st là tương ứng/phù hợp với.
entries.example: The journalist corresponded with several witnesses, and the correspondence was later used as evidence.

entries.meaning: có hoặc không có khả năng sẽ làm gì · khả năng xảy ra
entries.definition: Likely means expected to happen; likelihood is the degree of probability.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: be (un)likely to do st · likelihood (n).
entries.example: The proposal is likely to attract criticism, although the likelihood of legal action remains low.

entries.meaning: bài xã luận
entries.definition: An article that expresses a newspaper or editor's official opinion.
entries.example: The editorial argues that public-interest journalism needs stronger financial support.

entries.meaning: tạp chí hoặc chuyên san · bài báo, bài viết · nhà báo · ngành báo chí
entries.definition: A journal is a periodical containing articles; a journalist writes or reports for the field of journalism.
entries.note: journal là tạp chí/chuyên san; article là một bài trong journal/newspaper; journalist là người làm báo.
entries.example: A journalist wrote an article for the journal after completing the investigation.

entries.meaning: chế giễu · nực cười, lố bịch
entries.definition: To make fun of somebody; ridiculous describes something unreasonable or absurd.
entries.example: The presenter was criticized for ridiculing a guest and making a ridiculous claim.

entries.meaning: đề cập, nêu ra
entries.definition: To mention a subject so that it can be discussed.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: bring up st ~ mention st.
entries.example: The interviewer brought up the funding problem near the end of the discussion.

entries.meaning: nộp · phát, phân phát
entries.definition: To submit something versus to distribute something to a group.
entries.note: hand in là nộp; hand out là phát cho nhiều người.
entries.example: Students handed in their reports after the teacher handed out the assessment criteria.

entries.meaning: nhận ra, hiểu ra
entries.definition: To manage to see, hear, or understand something with difficulty.
entries.note: make out có thể là nhìn/nghe/hiểu ra khi khó nhận biết; ngữ cảnh quyết định nghĩa.
entries.example: From the blurred image, investigators could barely make out the vehicle's registration number.

entries.meaning: đề xuất, đưa ra để xem xét
entries.definition: To present an idea or proposal for other people to consider.
entries.example: The committee put forward a proposal to protect children from misleading advertising.

entries.meaning: nổi bật · xuất sắc, nổi trội
entries.definition: To be easily noticed because of a strong or unusual quality; outstanding means exceptionally good.
entries.example: Her evidence-based reporting stood out and later earned an outstanding journalism award.

entries.meaning: nhìn thấu ai/cái gì (ko bị lừa)
entries.definition: To understand the truth behind somebody's behaviour or an attempt to deceive.
entries.note: see through sb/st là nhận ra sự thật/ý đồ nên không bị lừa; không phải 'nhìn xuyên qua' theo nghĩa đen trong trường hợp này.
entries.example: Experienced readers can often see through an article that uses emotional language to hide weak evidence.

entries.meaning: bình thường, thông thường ~ phổ biến, thường gặp # được nhiều người yêu thích
entries.definition: Ordinary or normal means not unusual; common means frequent; popular means liked by many people.
entries.note: ordinary/normal là bình thường; common là thường gặp/phổ biến; popular là được nhiều người ưa thích.
entries.example: The documentary follows the ordinary routines of people whose experiences are rarely shown in the media.

entries.meaning: tai tiếng, khét tiếng vì điều xấu ~ nổi tiếng
entries.definition: Infamous and notorious mean well known for something bad; famous is neutral or positive unless the context says otherwise.
entries.note: infamous/notorious đều là nổi tiếng vì điều xấu; không dùng thay cho famous khi sắc thái tích cực/trung tính.
entries.example: The famous actor played an infamous leader who was notorious for cruelty.

entries.meaning: tán thành hoặc không tán thành điều gì ~ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý với ai hay ý kiến · sự tán thành hoặc không tán thành
entries.definition: To have a positive or negative opinion of something; approval and disapproval are the related nouns.
entries.note: approve of là tán thành/cho là tốt; agree with là đồng ý với ý kiến/người. Hai cụm gần nghĩa nhưng không hoàn toàn thay thế.
entries.example: Many residents approved of the plan, but others disagreed with its environmental impact.

entries.term: do sb a favour ~ help sb · owe sb a favour
entries.spoken: do somebody a favour , help somebody , owe somebody a favour
entries.meaning: giúp ai một việc · nợ ai một ân tình hoặc sự giúp đỡ
entries.definition: To help somebody, creating a favour that may later be returned.
entries.note: do sb a favour là giúp ai; owe sb a favour là mang ơn và nên giúp lại.
entries.example: A colleague did me a favour by covering my shift, so I still owe her a favour.

entries.meaning: phản đối
entries.definition: To express disagreement with or resistance to a proposal, idea, or action.
entries.note: object to + noun/V-ing; oppose + noun trực tiếp, không có to.
entries.example: Local groups objected to the proposal and formally opposed the destruction of the park.

entries.meaning: hỏi thăm sức khỏe hoặc tình hình của ai
entries.definition: To ask about somebody's health or situation.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: ask after sb.
entries.example: She called the hospital to ask after her neighbour following the operation.

entries.spoken: fall for (a trick or a lie)
entries.meaning: bị lừa
entries.definition: To be tricked into believing a lie or dishonest story.
entries.example: Several users fell for the false advertisement because it copied a trusted brand.

entries.term: look up to sb >< look down on sb
entries.spoken: look up to somebody , look down on somebody
entries.meaning: kính trọng, ngưỡng mộ ai · coi thường, khinh thường ai
entries.definition: To respect and admire somebody versus to consider somebody inferior.
entries.note: look up to là kính trọng; look down on là coi thường.
entries.example: Young athletes often look up to successful players, but they should never look down on beginners.

entries.meaning: qua đời, chết
entries.definition: A polite expression meaning to die.
entries.example: The writer passed away at the age of ninety, surrounded by members of her family.

entries.meaning: an cư lạc nghiệp
entries.definition: To begin a stable, quiet life, often with a permanent home or family.
entries.example: After years of travel, they settled down in a small town and started a family.

entries.meaning: bắt nạt, gây khó dễ hoặc thường xuyên chỉ trích ai
entries.definition: To repeatedly treat one person unfairly, criticize them, or bully them.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: pick on sb.
entries.example: Older students were warned not to pick on younger pupils during group activities.

entries.meaning: hạ bệ, chỉ trích ai
entries.definition: To criticize, humiliate, or make somebody feel less confident.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: put sb down.
entries.example: A good leader gives constructive feedback instead of putting team members down.

entries.term: take sb aback ~ surprise sb # take sb back
entries.spoken: take somebody aback , surprise somebody , take somebody back
entries.meaning: làm ai bất ngờ hoặc sửng sốt · đưa ai trở lại; gợi ai nhớ về quá khứ
entries.definition: Take somebody aback means surprise or shock them; take somebody back means return them somewhere or remind them of the past.
entries.note: Cụm đúng là take sb aback; take sb back lại thường là đưa ai trở lại hoặc gợi nhớ quá khứ.
entries.example: The news took her aback, while the old photograph took her back to her childhood.

entries.meaning: đứng về phe ai…
entries.definition: To defend or support somebody who is being criticized or treated unfairly.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: stand up for sb.
entries.example: Several witnesses stood up for the student after she was unfairly blamed.

entries.meaning: cãi nhau với ai
entries.definition: To have an argument and stop being friendly with somebody.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: fall out with sb.
entries.example: The two colleagues fell out over the report but continued to work professionally.

entries.meaning: làm lành, làm hòa
entries.definition: To become friendly again after an argument.
entries.note: make up có nhiều nghĩa; trong ngữ cảnh quan hệ, make up = làm hòa.
entries.example: They discussed the misunderstanding honestly and made up before the project ended.

entries.term: suspect sb of doing st · arrest sb for doing st · blame sb for doing st
entries.spoken: suspect somebody of doing something , arrest somebody for doing something , blame somebody for doing something
entries.meaning: nghi ai đã làm gì · bắt ai vì đã làm gì · trách hoặc đổ lỗi cho ai vì đã làm gì
entries.definition: Suspect, arrest, and blame describe different legal or personal actions and take of or for before an -ing form.
entries.note: suspect sb of, arrest sb for, blame sb for: ba động từ đi với giới từ khác nhau.
entries.example: Police suspected the driver of hiding evidence, arrested him for dangerous driving, and blamed poor visibility for the crash.

entries.term: accuse sb of doing st ~ charge sb with doing st
entries.spoken: accuse somebody of doing something , charge somebody with doing something
entries.meaning: buộc tội, cáo buộc ai đã làm gì
entries.definition: To formally say that somebody committed an offence; charge is the more official legal term.
entries.note: accuse sb of; charge sb with. charge là cáo buộc chính thức theo pháp luật hơn accuse.
entries.example: Prosecutors accused the company of fraud and charged two managers with falsifying records.

entries.meaning: người bị tình nghi # bị cáo, người đã bị buộc tội
entries.definition: A suspect is thought to be involved; the accused has been formally charged and is facing a court.
entries.note: suspect là người bị tình nghi; the accused là người đã bị cáo buộc và đang chịu xét xử.
entries.example: The suspect was questioned by police, while the accused appeared before the court the next morning.

entries.meaning: công lí, sự công bằng # quyền
entries.definition: Justice is fair treatment under law; a right is something a person is legally or morally entitled to.
entries.example: Access to justice is a basic right, but legal support is not equally available to everyone.

entries.meaning: truy tố hoặc khởi tố ai theo pháp luật · ngược đãi, bức hại ai dai dẳng
entries.definition: Prosecute means officially bring a legal case against somebody; persecute means repeatedly mistreat somebody for their identity or beliefs.
entries.note: prosecute là khởi tố/truy tố; đừng nhầm với persecute là ngược đãi dai dẳng vì bản sắc hoặc niềm tin.
entries.example: The state prosecuted the attackers for persecuting members of a religious minority.

entries.meaning: ngược đãi ai
entries.definition: To treat somebody cruelly or unfairly over time, often because of identity or beliefs.
entries.example: The minority group was persecuted for its beliefs and forced to leave the region.

entries.term: capital punishment (n) ~ death penalty (n) ~ death sentence (n)
entries.spoken: capital punishment , death penalty , death sentence
entries.meaning: hình phạt tử hình theo cách nói trang trọng ~ án tử hình ~ bản án tử hình cụ thể
entries.definition: The legal punishment of death for a serious crime.
entries.note: capital punishment/death penalty là hình phạt tử hình; death sentence là bản án tử hình cụ thể.
entries.example: The country abolished capital punishment, so courts can no longer impose the death penalty.

entries.meaning: phạt bằng đánh đập, nhục hình
entries.definition: Physical punishment intended to cause pain.
entries.example: International law prohibits corporal punishment in many educational and institutional settings.

entries.meaning: đột nhập nhà để trộm · kẻ đột nhập nhà để trộm ~ kẻ trộm nói chung · hành vi hoặc vụ trộm
entries.definition: To enter a building illegally to steal; a burglar does this, while thief and theft are more general.
entries.note: burglar đột nhập nhà/tòa nhà để trộm; thief là kẻ trộm nói chung; theft là hành vi/vụ trộm.
entries.example: A burglar entered the house at night, but the thief left before taking any valuable property.

entries.meaning: kẻ phá hoại của công
entries.definition: A person who deliberately damages public or private property.
entries.example: A vandal damaged public art and was ordered to pay for the repairs.

entries.term: sentence (v,n) · sentence sb to death · sentence sb to life
entries.spoken: sentence , sentence somebody to death , sentence somebody to life
entries.type: verb · noun · phrase / pattern · word family
entries.meaning: kết án; bản án · kết án ai tử hình · kết án ai tù chung thân
entries.definition: To officially give a punishment in court, including a death or life sentence.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: sentence (v,n) · sentence sb to death · sentence sb to life.
entries.example: The judge sentenced the offender to ten years in prison rather than sentencing him to life.

entries.meaning: chứng kiến · nhân chứng
entries.definition: To see an event happen, or a person who gives evidence about what they saw.
entries.example: Two neighbours witnessed the incident and later gave evidence as witnesses.

entries.term: on account of ~ because of # account for st
entries.spoken: on account of , because of , account for something
entries.meaning: bởi vì, do · giải thích; chiếm hoặc tạo nên một phần hay tỉ lệ
entries.definition: On account of means because of; account for means explain something or form a particular proportion of it.
entries.note: on account of là bởi vì hoặc do; account for là giải thích hoặc chiếm một tỉ lệ, không đồng nghĩa trong mọi cấu trúc.
entries.example: The match was cancelled on account of the storm, which also accounted for most travel delays.

entries.term: account for st ~ explain st · account for a proportion
entries.spoken: account for something , explain something , account for a proportion
entries.meaning: giải thích, lí giải điều gì ~ giải thích điều gì · chiếm hoặc tạo nên một phần/tỉ lệ
entries.definition: To explain the cause of something, or to form a stated proportion of a total.
entries.note: account for something có thể là giải thích điều gì; account for a proportion là chiếm một phần hoặc tỉ lệ
entries.example: Several economic factors account for the sudden rise in housing costs.

entries.term: take st into account ~ take st into consideration
entries.spoken: take something into account , take something into consideration
entries.meaning: cân nhắc, tính đến
entries.definition: To consider a fact or circumstance when making a decision.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: take st into account ~ take st into consideration.
entries.example: The judge took the offender's age and previous record into account before passing sentence.

entries.term: take advantage of st ~ make use of st
entries.spoken: take advantage of something , make use of something
entries.meaning: tận dụng, sử dụng điều gì có lợi
entries.definition: To use an opportunity or person for benefit, sometimes unfairly.
entries.note: take advantage of có thể trung tính 'tận dụng' hoặc tiêu cực 'lợi dụng'; make use of thường trung tính.
entries.example: Some companies take advantage of legal gaps, while responsible firms make use of them only fairly.

entries.meaning: nhầm A với B
entries.definition: To wrongly identify one person or thing as another.
entries.example: A witness mistook the second man for the suspect because they wore similar jackets.

entries.term: glance (v,n) ~ glimpse (v,n) · catch a glimpse of sb/st
entries.spoken: glance , glimpse , catch a glimpse of somebody or something
entries.type: verb · noun · phrase / pattern · word family
entries.meaning: liếc nhanh; cái liếc ~ thoáng thấy; cái nhìn thoáng · thoáng nhìn thấy ai hoặc điều gì
entries.definition: A glance is a deliberate quick look; a glimpse is a brief or accidental view.
entries.note: glance là chủ động nhìn nhanh; glimpse là thoáng thấy, thường tình cờ.
entries.example: She glanced at the screen deliberately but only caught a glimpse of the confidential message.

entries.meaning: xúc phạm; vi phạm · hành vi vi phạm hoặc tội · người phạm tội hoặc vi phạm pháp luật
entries.definition: To upset or break a rule; offence is the act, and offender is the person responsible.
entries.note: offence là hành vi/tội; offender là người phạm; criminal thường gợi tội nghiêm trọng hơn law-breaker.
entries.example: The offender was charged with an offence, but not every law-breaker is a serious criminal.

entries.meaning: rõ ràng, hiển nhiên hoặc có vẻ rõ · bằng chứng
entries.definition: Clearly seen or understood; evidence is information that supports a conclusion.
entries.example: The evidence made it evident that the damage was deliberate rather than accidental.

entries.meaning: ban hành luật…
entries.definition: To introduce a new law, rule, or system.
entries.example: The government brought in a new law requiring clearer online safety checks.

entries.meaning: làm chậm, gây trì hoãn ~ hoãn lại sang thời điểm khác
entries.definition: To delay something or make it happen later.
entries.note: hold up là gây chậm; put off là chủ động hoãn sang thời điểm khác.
entries.example: A security alert held up the train and put off the hearing until the afternoon.

entries.meaning: thả, tha cho ai
entries.definition: To allow somebody to avoid punishment or a serious consequence.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: let sb off.
entries.example: The judge let the teenager off with a warning because it was a first offence.

entries.meaning: lừa ai
entries.definition: To deceive or trick somebody.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: take sb in.
entries.example: The false website took several customers in by copying the bank's official design.

entries.meaning: điều tra, xem xét kĩ
entries.definition: To investigate or examine a matter carefully.
entries.example: Independent investigators will look into the complaint and publish their findings.

entries.meaning: kê đơn · đơn thuốc
entries.definition: To officially advise and authorize a particular medicine or treatment; prescription is the written instruction.
entries.example: The doctor prescribed antibiotics and explained every instruction on the prescription.

entries.meaning: làm nhiễm bệnh · có khả năng lây nhiễm · sự nhiễm bệnh hoặc nhiễm trùng · tiêm hoặc truyền vào · mũi tiêm, sự tiêm
entries.definition: Infect relates to disease transmission; inject means to put a substance into the body with a needle.
entries.note: infect/infection liên quan nhiễm bệnh; inject/injection liên quan tiêm. Hai nhóm gần giống chữ nhưng khác nghĩa hoàn toàn.
entries.example: The virus can infect patients and cause an infection, whereas a nurse injects medicine by giving an injection.

entries.meaning: lớp bột hoặc dụng cụ cố định xương gãy · băng quấn vết thương hoặc chỗ bị thương
entries.definition: A plaster or cast holds a broken bone in place; a bandage covers or supports an injured area.
entries.note: plaster/cast cố định xương gãy; bandage quấn và bảo vệ vết thương.
entries.example: The doctor put her broken arm in a cast and wrapped the cut in a clean bandage.

entries.meaning: phòng bệnh (trong bệnh viện)
entries.definition: A room or section of a hospital where patients receive care.
entries.example: Visitors must report to the nurses' station before entering the children's ward.

entries.meaning: liều thuốc
entries.definition: A measured amount of medicine taken at one time.
entries.example: Patients should never take more than the recommended dose of this medicine.

entries.meaning: bổ nhiệm · cuộc hẹn; sự bổ nhiệm
entries.definition: To officially choose somebody for a role; an appointment can also be an arranged meeting.
entries.note: appoint là bổ nhiệm; appointment là cuộc hẹn hoặc sự bổ nhiệm, tùy ngữ cảnh.
entries.example: The hospital appointed a new surgeon, and my appointment with her is on Friday.

entries.meaning: lan rộng/làm lan rộng · sự lan rộng hoặc phạm vi lan rộng
entries.definition: To extend something over a larger area or pass from one person or place to another; as a noun, spread is the process or extent of this movement.
entries.example: The rapid spread of the infection was controlled before it could spread to other buildings.

entries.term: attempt (v,n) ~ effort (n) · make an attempt ~ make an effort
entries.spoken: attempt , effort , make an attempt , make an effort
entries.meaning: thử hoặc cố làm; một lần thử ~ sự nỗ lực, công sức · thực hiện một lần thử ~ nỗ lực cố gắng
entries.definition: An act of trying to do something difficult; effort is the energy used.
entries.note: attempt là một lần thử; effort là công sức. make an attempt/effort đều đúng nhưng sắc thái khác nhau.
entries.example: Researchers made several attempts to develop the vaccine and invested considerable effort in each trial.

entries.meaning: đáng…
entries.definition: Used before an -ing form to say that something deserves the time or effort.
entries.note: worth là giới từ/tính từ đặc biệt, đi với noun hoặc V-ing: worth reading, không dùng worth to read.
entries.example: The treatment is worth considering because its benefits are supported by reliable evidence.

entries.meaning: nhấn mạnh · sự nhấn mạnh
entries.definition: To give special importance to something; emphasis is the related noun.
entries.example: The report emphasizes prevention, placing particular emphasis on regular screening.

entries.meaning: người nghiện · sự nghiện, chứng nghiện · gây nghiện · bị nghiện
entries.definition: An addict has an addiction; addictive describes something that can cause dependence, while addicted describes the affected person.
entries.note: addict là người nghiện; addictive mô tả thứ gây nghiện; addicted mô tả người bị nghiện.
entries.example: Nicotine is addictive, and an addicted smoker may need support to overcome the addiction.

entries.meaning: phẫu thuật · bác sĩ phẫu thuật · thuộc phẫu thuật
entries.definition: Medical treatment involving an operation; a surgeon performs it, and surgical is the adjective.
entries.note: surgery thường không đếm được khi nói chung/hành động phẫu thuật; surgeon là bác sĩ, surgical là tính từ.
entries.example: The surgeon performed the surgery using a less invasive surgical technique.

entries.meaning: bùng nổ (dịch bệnh, hỏa hoạn, thiên tai…)
entries.definition: To start suddenly and spread, especially a disease, fire, war, or disaster.
entries.example: A new strain of flu broke out shortly after the winter holiday.

entries.meaning: gây ra, dẫn đến
entries.definition: To cause an illness or unpleasant condition to develop.
entries.example: Lack of sleep can bring on headaches and reduce concentration.

entries.meaning: mắc bệnh (bệnh vặt)
entries.definition: To become ill with a usually minor disease.
entries.example: I came down with a mild cold but recovered after two days of rest.

entries.meaning: tỉnh lại (sau khi ngất/gây mê…)
entries.definition: To become conscious again after fainting or anaesthesia.
entries.example: The patient came round slowly after the operation and recognized the nurse.

entries.meaning: cảm thấy đủ khỏe để…
entries.definition: To feel healthy, energetic, or willing enough to do something.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: feel up to doing st.
entries.example: She did not feel up to attending class while she was recovering from the infection.

entries.meaning: vượt qua, khắc phục
entries.definition: To recover from an illness or successfully deal with a difficulty.
entries.note: get over thường là hồi phục sau bệnh/cú sốc; overcome nhấn mạnh vượt qua khó khăn bằng nỗ lực.
entries.example: Most patients get over the illness quickly, but some struggle to overcome the resulting fatigue.

entries.term: pass out ~ faint # pass away ~ die
entries.spoken: pass out , faint , pass away , die
entries.meaning: ngất, bất tỉnh · qua đời, chết
entries.definition: To become unconscious versus the polite expression for dying.
entries.note: pass out = ngất; pass away = qua đời. Hai cụm không liên quan nghĩa dù cùng bắt đầu bằng pass.
entries.example: He passed out because of the heat; his grandfather had passed away several years earlier.

entries.meaning: dần mất tác dụng hoặc cảm giác · mòn hỏng do sử dụng; làm ai kiệt sức
entries.definition: Wear off means gradually lose an effect or feeling; wear out means become unusable through use or make somebody exhausted.
entries.note: wear off là tác dụng/cảm giác giảm dần; wear out là vật bị mòn hỏng hoặc người kiệt sức.
entries.example: The medicine wore off before the old support bandage wore out.

entries.meaning: qua khỏi, sống sót sau bệnh hoặc tình trạng nguy hiểm
entries.definition: To survive and recover from a serious illness or dangerous situation.
entries.example: Despite serious injuries, the patient pulled through and later returned to work.

entries.meaning: băm/chặt nhỏ # thái thành lát # nạo/bào nhỏ
entries.definition: Chop means cut into pieces; slice means cut into thin flat pieces; grate means rub into very small strips.
entries.note: chop = chặt/thái nhỏ; slice = thái lát; grate = nạo/bào thành sợi.
entries.example: Chop the onions, slice the mushrooms, and grate the cheese before heating the pan.

entries.meaning: phong cách ẩm thực
entries.definition: A particular country's or region's style of cooking.
entries.example: The restaurant combines traditional Vietnamese cuisine with modern cooking techniques.

entries.meaning: ấm đun nước # ấm pha trà
entries.definition: A kettle boils water; a teapot holds and serves tea.
entries.note: kettle dùng đun nước; teapot dùng pha và đựng trà.
entries.example: Boil water in the kettle, then pour it into the teapot over the tea leaves.

entries.meaning: đã đông lạnh/đông cứng # lạnh cóng/rất lạnh
entries.definition: Frozen describes something made solid by cold; freezing describes extremely cold conditions.
entries.note: frozen mô tả thứ đã đông đá; freezing mô tả mức lạnh cực độ hoặc quá trình đang đông.
entries.example: Keep frozen food below zero, especially when the weather outside is freezing.

entries.meaning: đồ uống không cồn ~ đồ uống có ga ~ thức uống nói chung
entries.definition: A soft drink has no alcohol; a fizzy drink is carbonated; beverage is a general formal word for a drink.
entries.note: soft drink là đồ uống không cồn; fizzy drink là đồ uống có ga; beverage là từ khái quát, trang trọng hơn drink.
