entries.example: A soft drink contains no alcohol, a fizzy drink is carbonated, and beverage is the general term.

entries.meaning: danh mục sản phẩm
entries.definition: A complete organized list of products or items, often with descriptions and prices.
entries.example: The online catalogue provides ingredients, prices, and allergy information for every product.

entries.type: noun · adjective · phrase / pattern · word family
entries.meaning: dịp/sự kiện · thỉnh thoảng xảy ra · thỉnh thoảng
entries.definition: A particular event or suitable time; occasional means happening sometimes; on occasion means sometimes.
entries.example: We reserve this restaurant for special occasions, although we also visit it on occasion.

entries.term: reserve (v) ~ book (v) · reservation (n) · make a reservation
entries.spoken: reserve , book , reservation , make a reservation
entries.meaning: đặt trước · sự/việc đặt chỗ · thực hiện việc đặt chỗ
entries.definition: To arrange in advance for a seat, room, or service; reservation is the arrangement.
entries.example: I booked a table online, and the restaurant confirmed the reservation immediately.

entries.term: associate (v) A with B · related to ~ associated with
entries.spoken: associate A with B , related to , associated with
entries.meaning: liên hệ một người/vật với một người/vật khác · có liên quan đến
entries.definition: To connect A with B in thought; related to and associated with describe the connection.
entries.example: Many consumers associate organic food with health, although the two are not always directly related.

entries.term: compliment (v) sb on st ~ pay sb a compliment # congratulate (v) sb on st
entries.spoken: compliment somebody on something , pay somebody a compliment , congratulate somebody on something
entries.meaning: khen ai về điều gì # chúc mừng ai về điều gì
entries.definition: To praise somebody for something; congratulate is used for an achievement or special event.
entries.note: compliment sb on st là khen ai về điều gì; congratulate sb on st là chúc mừng ai về thành tích hoặc sự kiện.
entries.example: I complimented the chef on the meal and congratulated her on winning the competition.

entries.term: lack (v) st · lack (n) of st · lacking (a) in st
entries.spoken: lack something , lack of something , lacking in something
entries.type: verb · noun · adjective · phrase / pattern · word family
entries.meaning: thiếu điều gì · sự thiếu hụt điều gì · thiếu về mặt nào đó
entries.definition: To not have enough of something; lack is also a noun, and lacking in describes a missing quality.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: lack (v) st · lack (n) of st · lacking (a) in st.
entries.example: The diet lacks iron, and a lack of protein may leave some patients lacking in energy.

entries.meaning: coi/xem là
entries.definition: To consider or describe somebody or something as having a particular quality.
entries.example: Nutritionists regard the product as healthy, but some consumers consider it too expensive.

entries.type: verb · noun · phrase / pattern · word family
entries.meaning: có xu hướng làm gì · xu hướng/khuynh hướng
entries.definition: To usually behave in a particular way; tendency is the related noun.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: tend (v) to V · tendency (n).
entries.example: People tend to eat more slowly in formal restaurants, a tendency observed in several studies.

entries.meaning: lo lắng/bồn chồn · sự lo âu
entries.definition: Worried or nervous about a possible event; anxiety is the feeling or condition.
entries.note: anxious thường là lo lắng; trong anxious to V, từ này có thể mang nghĩa rất mong muốn.
entries.example: She felt anxious about the allergy test, but the nurse helped reduce her anxiety.

entries.meaning: trân trọng/đánh giá cao · biết trân trọng · đáng kể/có thể nhận thấy
entries.definition: To value or understand something positively; appreciative describes gratitude, while appreciable means noticeable or considerable.
entries.note: appreciative = biết trân trọng; appreciable = đủ lớn để nhận thấy/đáng kể, gần considerable.
entries.example: Customers appreciated the careful service, and an appreciable improvement in quality was soon visible.

entries.meaning: sự tạo ra/sản phẩm được tạo ra · khả năng sáng tạo · sinh vật
entries.definition: Creation is something made or the act of making; creativity is the ability; a creature is a living being.
entries.note: creation là thứ/sự được tạo ra; creativity là khả năng sáng tạo; creature là sinh vật.
entries.example: The chef's latest creation shows great creativity and is shaped like a sea creature.

entries.meaning: nguyên bản/độc đáo · tính độc đáo
entries.definition: New, unique, or not copied; originality is the quality of being original.
entries.example: The recipe is original, and its originality lies in the unusual combination of flavours.

entries.meaning: kĩ lưỡng/toàn diện · một cách kĩ lưỡng/hoàn toàn
entries.definition: Careful and complete; thoroughly means completely or in a detailed way.
entries.note: thorough là tính từ 'kĩ lưỡng'; thoroughly là trạng từ 'một cách kĩ càng/hoàn toàn'.
entries.example: Inspect the ingredients thoroughly so that the safety check is both careful and thorough.

entries.meaning: ghé thăm
entries.definition: To make a short informal visit to somebody, often without arranging it.
entries.example: We dropped in on our neighbours and shared some food after the festival.

entries.meaning: đến lúc/đến giờ…
entries.definition: To be approaching a particular time or age.
entries.example: It was getting on for midnight when the final guests left the restaurant.

entries.meaning: - nổ (bom, súng) - reo (báo thức, chuông) - ôi, thiu, thối (đồ ăn)
entries.definition: To explode, ring, or become bad and unsafe to eat, depending on context.
entries.note: go off có nhiều nghĩa: chuông reo, bom nổ, thức ăn hỏng hoặc mất thích thú; phải đọc cả ngữ cảnh.
entries.example: The alarm went off after the food had gone off, and the smell filled the kitchen.

entries.meaning: để lại/bỏ lại phía sau # bỏ sót/loại ra
entries.definition: Leave behind means not take somebody or something; leave out means omit or exclude.
entries.note: leave behind là để lại phía sau; leave out là bỏ sót/loại khỏi danh sách.
entries.example: Do not leave a child behind or leave important allergy information out of the booking form.

entries.meaning: làm cho ai đó chán
entries.definition: To make somebody lose interest in or dislike something.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: put sb off st.
entries.example: The strong smell put several customers off ordering the seafood dish.

entries.term: run into ~ come across ~ bump into
entries.spoken: run into , come across , bump into
entries.meaning: tình cờ bắt gặp
entries.definition: Run into and bump into usually mean meet somebody unexpectedly; come across can also mean find somebody or something by chance.
entries.note: run into và bump into thường dùng khi tình cờ gặp người; come across còn dùng khi tình cờ tìm thấy vật hoặc thông tin
entries.example: She ran into an old classmate and later came across his research article online.

entries.meaning: bắt đầu thích / bắt đầu quen với cái gì
entries.definition: To begin to like something or become accustomed to it.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: take to st.
entries.example: She quickly took to the local cuisine after learning how each dish was prepared.

entries.meaning: mặc/đeo thử # thử nghiệm/kiểm tra
entries.definition: Try on means wear something to test fit; try out means test performance or suitability.
entries.note: try on dùng với quần áo; try out dùng khi thử nghiệm ý tưởng, thiết bị hoặc người cho một vai trò.
entries.example: Try the jacket on for size, but try the new recipe out before serving it to guests.

entries.meaning: hóa ra là…
entries.definition: To be discovered or proved to be a particular thing.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: turn out to V.
entries.example: The cheap appliance turned out to use more electricity than the older model.

entries.meaning: xuất hiện, đến
entries.definition: To arrive or appear, sometimes unexpectedly.
entries.example: Only twelve guests turned up, although twenty people had accepted the invitation.

entries.meaning: ghê tởm, kinh khủng
entries.definition: Extremely unpleasant and causing strong dislike.
entries.example: The milk smelled disgusting, so we checked the date and threw it away.

entries.meaning: bằng cấp/năng lực chuyên môn # chất lượng/phẩm chất
entries.definition: A qualification proves training or ability; quality means a standard or personal characteristic.
entries.note: qualification là bằng cấp/năng lực được chứng nhận; quality là chất lượng hoặc phẩm chất.
entries.example: A teaching qualification proves professional training, whereas quality describes how good the teaching is.

entries.term: degree (n) ~ diploma (n) · high school diploma # licence/license (n) · driving licence/license ~ permit (n) · work permit
entries.spoken: degree , diploma , high school diploma , licence or license , driving licence or license , permit , work permit
entries.ipa: degree /dɪˈɡriː/ · diploma /dɪˈploʊmɑ/ · high /haɪ/ · school /skuːl/ · licence /ˈlaɪsəns/ · license /ˈlaɪsəns/ · driving /ˈdraɪvɪŋ/ · permit /ˈpɝːmɪt/ · work /wɝːk/
entries.meaning: bằng đại học ~ văn bằng/chứng chỉ · bằng tốt nghiệp trung học # giấy phép · giấy phép lái xe ~ giấy phép cho một hoạt động · giấy phép lao động
entries.definition: A degree or diploma is an educational award; a licence or permit gives official permission for an activity.
entries.note: degree thường là bằng đại học; diploma là văn bằng; licence/license và permit đều là giấy phép nhưng dùng theo loại hoạt động.
entries.example: She earned a university degree, holds a high-school diploma, and needs a work permit to take the job.

entries.term: attend (v) st · attendance (n) # attend (v) to sb/st · attention (n) · draw sb's attention to st
entries.spoken: attend something , attendance , attend to somebody or something , attention , draw somebody's attention to something
entries.type: verb · noun · phrase / pattern · word family
entries.meaning: tham dự điều gì · sự có mặt/chuyên cần # chăm sóc/xử lí ai hoặc việc gì · sự chú ý · khiến ai chú ý đến điều gì
entries.definition: Attend something means be present; attend to means deal with; attention is focused notice.
entries.note: attend + sự kiện/lớp; attend to = xử lí/chăm sóc; attention là danh từ.
entries.example: Students attend the lecture, while staff attend to technical problems and draw attention to key evidence.

entries.term: make up one’s mind · be in two minds about st · to my mind ~ in my opinion · cross one’s mind · bear st in mind
entries.spoken: make up one’s mind , be in two minds about something , to my mind , in my opinion , cross one’s mind , bear something in mind
entries.ipa: make /meɪk/ · up /ʌp/ · mind /maɪnd/ · two /tuː/ · minds /maɪndz/ · about /əˈbaʊt/ · my /maɪ/ · opinion /əˈpɪnjən/ · cross /krɔːs/ · bear /bɛr/
entries.meaning: đưa ra quyết định · phân vân về điều gì · theo ý kiến của tôi ~ theo quan điểm của tôi · nảy ra trong đầu · ghi nhớ khi cân nhắc
entries.definition: These expressions with mind describe deciding, being uncertain, giving an opinion, thinking of something briefly, or remembering something while deciding.
entries.note: make up one's mind là quyết định; be in two minds là phân vân; to my mind gần nghĩa với in my opinion; cross one's mind là chợt nghĩ đến; bear something in mind là ghi nhớ khi cân nhắc
entries.example: The idea crossed her mind while she was in two minds about the course; to my mind, she should bear the deadline in mind before making up her mind.

entries.term: There is no point (in) V-ing ~ It is no use V-ing
entries.spoken: There is no point (in) doing , It is no use doing
entries.ipa: there /ðɛr/ · is /ɪz/ · no /noʊ/ · point /pɔɪnt/ · it /ɪt/ · use /juːs/
entries.meaning: vô ích, vô nghĩa khi làm gì
entries.definition: Used to say that an action has no useful purpose.
entries.note: There is no point (in) V-ing và It is no use V-ing đều theo sau bằng V-ing.
entries.example: There is no point memorizing a rule if students never use it in context.

entries.term: make sense # a sense of + noun
entries.spoken: make sense , a sense of + noun
entries.meaning: có lí/dễ hiểu · ý thức/cảm nhận về một điều
entries.definition: Make sense means be understandable; a sense of something can describe an awareness or personal quality.
entries.note: make sense là có lí hoặc dễ hiểu; a sense of + noun diễn tả ý thức hoặc cảm nhận về một phẩm chất
entries.example: The explanation makes sense, and a strong sense of responsibility helps learners work independently.

entries.meaning: khoe khoang, khoác lác…
entries.definition: To speak too proudly about achievements or possessions.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: boast (v) of/about st.
entries.example: The student boasted about his result, although the group project depended on everyone's effort.

entries.term: capable of V-ing ~ able to V
entries.spoken: capable of doing , able to verb
entries.meaning: có khả năng làm gì
entries.definition: Having the ability needed to do something; followed by of plus an -ing form.
entries.note: capable of V-ing; able to V. Không dùng capable to V.
entries.example: She is capable of analysing complex evidence and is able to explain it clearly.

entries.meaning: thất bại; sự thất bại
entries.definition: A lack of success, or an unsuccessful person, action, or system.
entries.note: failure /ˈfeɪljɚ/: phần -ure không đọc tách thành một âm tiết /jʊər/ đầy đủ.
entries.example: Failure can provide useful feedback when learners examine why an approach did not work.

entries.meaning: mãnh liệt/cực độ · cường độ
entries.definition: Very strong or extreme; intensity is the degree of strength.
entries.example: The course requires intense study, and the intensity increases before the final examination.

entries.term: literate (a) >< illiterate (a) · literacy (n) >< illiteracy (n) # literal (a) # literary (a) · literature (n)
entries.spoken: literate , illiterate , literacy , illiteracy , literal , literary , literature
entries.ipa: literate /ˈlɪtɚət/ · illiterate /ˌɪˈlɪtɚət/ · literacy /ˈlɪtɚəsi/ · illiteracy /ˌɪˈlɪtɚəsi/ · literal /ˈlɪtɚəl/ · literary /ˈlɪtɚˌɛri/ · literature /ˈlɪtɚətʃɚ/
entries.meaning: biết chữ >< mù chữ · khả năng biết đọc viết >< tình trạng mù chữ # theo nghĩa đen # thuộc văn chương · văn học
entries.definition: Literate relates to reading and writing; literal means exact, while literary and literature relate to written art.
entries.note: literal = theo nghĩa đen; literary = thuộc văn chương; literature = văn học. Đây là nhóm dễ nhầm chữ.
entries.example: Literacy supports learning; literal meaning differs from literary language and the study of literature.

entries.meaning: học giả, người nghiên cứu
entries.definition: A highly educated person who studies a subject in depth.
entries.example: The visiting scholar has published research on second-language learning and memory.

entries.meaning: chăm học
entries.definition: Spending a lot of time studying and showing serious academic interest.
entries.example: A studious learner works consistently but also chooses effective study methods.

entries.meaning: một ý nghĩ · quá trình/cách tư duy
entries.definition: A thought is a particular idea; thinking is the process of forming and examining ideas.
entries.note: thought là một ý nghĩ/sản phẩm suy nghĩ; thinking là quá trình/cách tư duy.
entries.example: A thought may be brief, while critical thinking is a deliberate process of analysing evidence.

entries.meaning: trở nên phổ biến · hiểu ra
entries.definition: To understand something, or to become popular.
entries.note: catch on có thể là trở nên phổ biến hoặc hiểu ra; tân ngữ/ngữ cảnh quyết định.
entries.example: The new revision method caught on quickly after students realized that it saved time.

entries.meaning: dần đồng ý với điều gì sau khi được thuyết phục
entries.definition: To eventually accept an idea after discussion or persuasion.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: come round to st.
entries.example: He eventually came round to the teacher's view after examining the data.

entries.meaning: ai đó chợt hiểu ra rằng… · bình minh
entries.definition: For an idea or fact to suddenly become clear to somebody; dawn also means first light.
entries.note: It dawned on sb that... = ai đó chợt hiểu ra; dawn (n) theo nghĩa đen là bình minh.
entries.example: It dawned on her that the two sources reported the same event from different perspectives.

entries.meaning: ám chỉ…
entries.definition: To indirectly suggest or imply something.
entries.example: I understand the facts, but I am not sure what the writer is getting at.

entries.meaning: đầu hàng, nhượng bộ
entries.definition: To stop resisting and agree to what somebody wants.
entries.example: The group refused to give in and continued searching for a better solution.

entries.meaning: bỏ (học, cuộc thi…)
entries.definition: To leave a course, school, or competition before completing it.
entries.example: Several students dropped out of the course because they could not manage the workload.

entries.meaning: vượt qua dễ dàng
entries.definition: To pass or complete something difficult very easily.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: sail through st.
entries.example: She sailed through the interview because she had prepared detailed examples.

entries.meaning: trình bày và sắp xếp các ý tưởng rõ ràng
entries.definition: To present and organize ideas clearly, usually in speech or writing.
entries.example: The introduction sets out the main ideas before the essay develops each one.

entries.term: suburb (n) · in the suburbs ~ on the outskirts
entries.spoken: suburb , in the suburbs , on the outskirts
entries.meaning: khu ngoại ô · ở vùng ngoại ô
entries.definition: A residential area outside a city centre; the outskirts are the outer parts of a town or city.
entries.note: suburb là khu ngoại ô; outskirts là vùng rìa thành phố và luôn ở dạng số nhiều: on the outskirts.
entries.example: The family lives in a quiet suburb on the outskirts of the capital.

entries.meaning: khói và sương mù · khói sương ô nhiễm
entries.definition: Air pollution formed by a mixture of smoke and fog.
entries.example: Heavy traffic produced smog that reduced visibility across the city centre.

entries.term: litter (n) ~ rubbish (n) ~ trash (n) ~ garbage (n) ~ waste (n) · industrial waste · domestic/household waste
entries.spoken: litter , rubbish , trash , garbage , waste , industrial waste , domestic or household waste
entries.ipa: litter /ˈlɪtɚ/ · rubbish /ˈrʌbɪʃ/ · trash /træʃ/ · garbage /ˈɡɑːrbɪdʒ/ · waste /weɪst/ · industrial /ˌɪˈndʌstriəl/ · domestic /dəˈmɛstɪk/ · household /ˈhaʊˌshoʊld/
entries.meaning: rác bị vứt bừa bãi ~ rác hoặc chất thải nói chung · chất thải công nghiệp · chất thải sinh hoạt
entries.definition: Litter is small waste left in public; rubbish, trash, and garbage are general household waste; waste is the broad formal term.
entries.note: litter là rác bị vứt bừa bãi; rubbish (BrE), trash/garbage (AmE) là rác nói chung; waste thường dùng trong ngữ cảnh môi trường/sản xuất.
entries.example: Litter is waste dropped in public places; rubbish, trash, and garbage are broader everyday terms.

entries.meaning: mưa như trút # trận mưa như trút # mưa rào # mưa phùn
entries.definition: When rain pours, it falls very heavily; a downpour is a period of very heavy rain, a shower is brief, and drizzle is very light rain.
entries.note: pour là động từ chỉ mưa như trút; downpour là trận mưa rất to; shower là mưa rào ngắn; drizzle là mưa phùn nhẹ
entries.example: Rain poured for an hour during the downpour, followed by a brief shower and light drizzle.

entries.meaning: vũng nước nhỏ # hồ chứa nước
entries.definition: A puddle is a small pool of water; a reservoir is a large artificial lake used to store water.
entries.note: puddle là vũng nước nhỏ; reservoir là hồ chứa nước lớn, thường do con người tạo.
entries.example: Rainwater formed a small puddle, but the reservoir remained below its normal level.

entries.meaning: vùng đồng bằng
entries.definition: A large area of flat land with few trees.
entries.example: The river crosses a wide plain before reaching the sea.

entries.term: fuss (n) · make a fuss # mess (n) · make a mess
entries.spoken: fuss , make a fuss , mess , make a mess
entries.meaning: sự ầm ĩ/lo lắng không cần thiết · làm ầm lên # tình trạng bừa bộn · làm bừa bộn/gây rối
entries.definition: A fuss is unnecessary excitement or complaint; a mess is a dirty or disorganized state.
entries.note: make a fuss = làm ầm/chuyện bé xé ra to; make a mess = làm bừa bộn hoặc gây rối.
entries.example: Residents made a fuss about the delay, but the storm had already made a mess of the roads.

entries.meaning: ko khỏe; bị ốm nhẹ
entries.definition: Slightly ill or feeling unwell.
entries.example: I felt under the weather, so I stayed indoors during the cold morning.

entries.meaning: đúng với thực tế ~ chính xác đến từng chi tiết >< không chính xác · độ chính xác >< sự sai lệch
entries.definition: Correct and exact; precise often emphasizes fine detail, while accuracy is the noun.
entries.note: accurate là đúng; precise là chính xác, nhất quán đến chi tiết. Một kết quả có thể precise nhưng chưa accurate.
entries.example: The instrument provides accurate measurements, although greater precision is needed for the final calculation.

entries.meaning: không gây hại # không bị tổn hại/nguyên vẹn
entries.definition: Harmless means not causing harm; unharmed means not injured or damaged.
entries.note: harmless = không gây hại; unharmed = không bị hại.
entries.example: The chemical is harmless to adults, and the workers escaped the accident unharmed.

entries.spoken: likely (a or adv) , possible , unlikely , likelihood
entries.meaning: có khả năng cao ~ có thể xảy ra >< ít có khả năng · khả năng/xác suất
entries.definition: Expected or possible to happen; likelihood is the degree of probability.
entries.note: likely thường dùng trong be likely to/It is likely that; possible mô tả khả năng có thể xảy ra nhưng không trực tiếp chỉ xác suất cao.
entries.example: Heavy rain is likely tonight, but flooding is only possible in low-lying areas.

entries.term: reside (v) ~ dwell (v) ~ inhabit (v) · resident (n) ~ inhabitant (n) ~ dweller (n)
entries.spoken: reside , dwell , inhabit , resident , inhabitant , dweller
entries.ipa: reside /rɪˈzaɪd/ · dwell /dwɛl/ · inhabit /ˌɪˈnhæbət/ · resident /ˈrɛzɪdənt/ · inhabitant /ɪˈnhæbətənt/ · dweller /ˈdwɛlɚ/
entries.meaning: cư trú/sinh sống · cư dân/người sinh sống
entries.definition: To live in a place; resident, inhabitant, and dweller refer to people who live there.
entries.example: Several species inhabit the forest, while only a small number of residents dwell nearby.

entries.meaning: làm giảm/hạ xuống # cải thiện/làm tốt hơn # thúc đẩy
entries.definition: To make something lower, better, or more advanced.
entries.note: lower là làm giảm; better là cải thiện nhưng thường gặp nhất trong better oneself hoặc better conditions; further là thúc đẩy
entries.example: The programme lowered costs and furthered public understanding, while evening classes helped workers better themselves.

entries.meaning: kêu gọi; đòi hỏi phải có…
entries.definition: To require something, or to publicly ask for action.
entries.example: The worsening drought calls for immediate action and requires careful water management.

entries.meaning: trời quang mây tạnh
entries.definition: For cloudy or rainy weather to become bright and dry.
entries.example: The sky cleared up after the storm, allowing rescue aircraft to take off.

entries.meaning: trang trí, sửa sang · cài, kéo khóa hoặc đóng cúc
entries.definition: To decorate or repair something, or to fasten clothes.
entries.example: They did up the old house and did up their coats before going outside.

entries.term: get sb down # let sb down
entries.spoken: get somebody down , let somebody down
entries.meaning: làm ai buồn/chán nản # làm ai thất vọng
entries.definition: Get somebody down means make them sad; let somebody down means disappoint them.
entries.note: get sb down = làm ai chán nản; let sb down = làm ai thất vọng vì không đáp ứng mong đợi.
entries.example: Continuous bad news got the volunteers down, but the delayed support also let them down.

entries.meaning: quy cho A là tại B
entries.definition: To believe that B is the cause of A.
entries.example: Scientists put the decline in fish numbers down to rising water temperatures.

entries.meaning: bắt đầu và có vẻ sẽ kéo dài (thời tiết/xu hướng xấu)
entries.definition: For unpleasant weather or a negative trend to begin and probably continue.
entries.note: set in nói về thời tiết/xu hướng xấu bắt đầu và có vẻ kéo dài, không chỉ là 'sắp xảy ra'.
entries.example: A period of severe weather set in and continued for more than a week.

entries.term: tear down st ~ destroy st # tear up st
entries.spoken: tear down something , destroy something , tear up something
entries.meaning: phá dỡ/phá hủy công trình ~ phá hủy công trình # xé nát
entries.definition: Tear down means destroy a structure; tear up means rip something into pieces.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: tear down st ~ destroy st # tear up st.
entries.example: Workers tore down the unsafe wall, while the office tore up the outdated plan.

entries.term: stand for · stand up for sb · stand in for sb
entries.spoken: stand for , stand up for somebody , stand in for somebody
entries.meaning: viết tắt/đại diện cho · bảo vệ/ủng hộ ai · thay tạm ai
entries.definition: Stand for means represent; stand up for means defend; stand in for means temporarily replace.
entries.note: stand for = viết tắt/đại diện; stand up for = bảo vệ; stand in for = thay tạm.
entries.example: UN stands for the United Nations; volunteers stand up for residents and stand in for absent staff.

entries.meaning: thuộc kinh tế · tiết kiệm/không tốn kém · nền kinh tế · môn kinh tế học
entries.definition: Economic relates to the economy; economical means saving money or resources; the economy is a system of production and trade, while economics is the academic subject.
entries.note: economic = thuộc kinh tế; economical = tiết kiệm; economy = nền kinh tế; economics = môn kinh tế học.
entries.example: Economic growth slowed, so families chose more economical products while students studied economics and the wider economy.

entries.meaning: biên lai; biên nhận
entries.definition: A written or printed record showing that money or goods have been received.
entries.example: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the product or prove the purchase.

entries.term: car make (n) ~ make of car # brand (n)
entries.spoken: car make , make of car , brand
entries.meaning: hãng/nhà sản xuất xe ~ hãng xe # thương hiệu hoặc nhãn hiệu nói chung
entries.definition: A car make is its manufacturer; brand is the general commercial name of a product.
entries.note: make dùng riêng cho nhà sản xuất/kiểu xe; brand rộng hơn, dùng cho nhiều loại sản phẩm.
entries.example: The car make is printed on the front, while the brand covers a wider range of products.

entries.meaning: mặc cả · món hời
entries.definition: To negotiate a price; a bargain is also something bought for less than its usual value.
entries.note: bargain (v) = mặc cả; a bargain (n) = món mua hời.
entries.example: She bargained with the seller and bought the jacket at a genuine bargain.

entries.meaning: tiền lẻ/tiền thối lại # tiền mặt
entries.definition: Change is coins or money returned after payment; cash is physical money.
entries.note: cash là tiền mặt; change là tiền lẻ hoặc tiền thối lại.
entries.example: I paid in cash and checked the change before leaving the checkout.

entries.meaning: quầy/khu thanh toán # máy/ngăn đựng tiền tại quầy
entries.definition: A checkout is where customers pay; a till is the machine or drawer that holds money.
entries.note: checkout là quầy/khu thanh toán; till là máy/ngăn đựng tiền tại quầy.
entries.example: Customers pay at the checkout, and the cashier stores notes and coins in the till.

entries.meaning: lượng của thứ không đếm được ~ số lượng của thứ đếm được
entries.definition: Amount is used mainly with uncountable nouns; number is used with countable nouns.
entries.note: amount of + danh từ không đếm được; number of + danh từ đếm được số nhiều.
entries.example: Use amount with uncountable nouns, such as money, and number with countable nouns, such as items.

entries.term: charge (v) sb money for st · charge (n) ~ fee (n) # fine (n) # fare (n) # cost (n) ~ expense (n) # price (n) · at the cost/expense of · be in charge of ~ be responsible for · charge sb with st ~ accuse sb of st
entries.spoken: charge somebody money for something , charge , fee , fine , fare , cost , expense , price , at the cost or expense of , be in charge of , be responsible for , charge somebody with something , accuse somebody of something
entries.ipa: charge /tʃɑːrdʒ/ · money /ˈmʌni/ · fee /fiː/ · fine /faɪn/ · fare /fɛr/ · cost /kɑːst/ · expense /ɪˈkspɛns/ · price /praɪs/ · responsible /riˈspɑːnsəbəl/ · accuse /əˈkjuːz/
entries.type: verb · noun · phrase / pattern · word family
entries.meaning: tính/thu của ai số tiền cho việc gì · khoản phí dịch vụ # tiền phạt # tiền tàu xe # chi phí # giá bán · với cái giá là/gây tổn hại cho · phụ trách/chịu trách nhiệm về · buộc tội ai về việc gì
entries.definition: Charge can mean ask somebody to pay or formally accuse somebody. A charge or fee is payment for a service; a fine is a penalty, a fare pays for travel, cost and expense describe money used, and price is the amount asked. Other patterns express sacrifice or responsibility.
entries.note: charge/fee là phí dịch vụ; fine là tiền phạt; fare là tiền tàu xe; price là mức giá; cost/expense là chi phí; in charge of là phụ trách; charge somebody with và accuse somebody of đều dùng khi buộc tội
entries.example: The hotel charged us a service fee, while the train fare and ticket price were separate expenses; the manager in charge was later accused of hiding the extra cost.

entries.meaning: yêu cầu, đòi hỏi · nhu cầu về điều gì
entries.definition: To ask firmly for something; as a noun, the need or desire for a product or service.
entries.note: demand (n) for st; demand (v) st/to V/that-clause. Không dùng demand for khi demand là động từ có tân ngữ trực tiếp.
entries.example: Consumers demanded lower prices as demand for cheaper products increased during the economic slowdown.

entries.meaning: chịu quá đủ rồi (phàn nàn)
entries.definition: To be unable or unwilling to tolerate any more of something.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: have enough of st.
entries.example: Customers had had enough of hidden charges and complained to the manager.

entries.term: not … in the least ~ not … at all
entries.spoken: not … in the least , not … at all
entries.meaning: không… một chút nào cả
entries.definition: Not at all or not in any degree.
entries.example: The cheaper model is not in the least unreliable; in fact, it performs very well.

entries.term: take notice of ~ pay attention to # at short notice
entries.spoken: take notice of , pay attention to , at short notice
entries.meaning: chú ý đến ~ chú ý đến # với rất ít thời gian báo trước
entries.definition: To pay attention to something; at short notice means with little warning time.
entries.note: take notice of/pay attention to = chú ý; at short notice = với rất ít thời gian báo trước.
entries.example: Please take notice of the change, although it was announced at very short notice.

entries.meaning: tài chính
entries.definition: The management of money by a person, business, or government.
entries.example: The finance department reviews spending, income, and long-term investment plans.

entries.meaning: đầu tư vào điều gì · khoản/sự đầu tư · nhà đầu tư
entries.definition: To put money, time, or resources into something in the hope of future benefit.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: invest in st · investment (n) · investor (n).
entries.example: The investor invested in renewable energy, and the investment created local jobs.

entries.meaning: xoay sở
entries.definition: To manage to live or deal with a situation using limited money or resources.
entries.example: The family can get by on a limited income because they plan every expense carefully.

entries.term: make up for st ~ compensate for st
entries.spoken: make up for something , compensate for something
entries.meaning: đền bù; bù đắp
entries.definition: To compensate for a loss, disadvantage, or mistake.
entries.note: make up for là bù đắp thiếu sót/mất mát; compensate sb for st thường có người nhận bồi thường rõ ràng.
entries.example: A later discount made up for the delivery delay and compensated customers for the inconvenience.

entries.meaning: làm lộ ra; tiết lộ…
entries.definition: To reveal information, especially a secret, sometimes unintentionally.
entries.note: give away thường là vô tình làm lộ; reveal/disclose trung tính hoặc trang trọng hơn.
entries.example: The unusual payment pattern gave away the fraud and disclosed the buyer's real identity.

entries.term: put by / put aside ~ set by / set aside
entries.spoken: put by or put aside , set by or set aside
entries.meaning: dành dụm; tiết kiệm (tiền; thời gian…)
entries.definition: To save money, time, or resources for future use.
entries.note: put/set money aside là dành dụm; set sth aside còn có thể tạm gác một vấn đề.
entries.example: She puts money aside each month and sets time aside to review her budget.

entries.meaning: thừa kế
entries.definition: To receive money or property unexpectedly, especially through inheritance.
entries.example: He came into a small inheritance after a relative passed away.

entries.meaning: tập dượt/diễn tập · buổi/sự tập dượt
entries.definition: To practise a performance before presenting it; rehearsal is the practice session.
entries.example: The actors rehearsed the final scene twice before the evening rehearsal.

entries.meaning: cảnh phim/sân khấu · phong cảnh chung ~ tầm nhìn/cảnh nhìn từ một nơi ~ cảnh vật cụ thể nhìn thấy
entries.definition: A scene is part of a film or play; scenery is the general landscape; view is what can be seen from a position; sight is a particular thing seen.
entries.note: scene là cảnh phim/sân khấu; scenery là phong cảnh chung; view là tầm nhìn; sight là cảnh cụ thể.
entries.example: The scene was filmed in mountain scenery, where the view became the film's most memorable sight.

entries.meaning: dàn nhạc # dàn hợp xướng
entries.definition: An orchestra is a large group of instrumentalists; a choir is a group of singers.
entries.note: orchestra là dàn nhạc; choir là dàn hợp xướng gồm người hát.
entries.example: The orchestra played below the stage while the choir performed behind the actors.

entries.meaning: tác phẩm/văn học hư cấu · hư cấu/không có thật
entries.definition: Stories and characters that are invented rather than factual; fictional is the adjective.
entries.note: fiction là danh từ không đếm được chỉ tác phẩm hư cấu; fictional là tính từ 'hư cấu'.
entries.example: The novel is fiction, but its fictional society reflects real political concerns.

entries.meaning: hãy tự nhiên như ở nhà
entries.definition: A friendly invitation telling a guest to relax as if in their own home.
entries.example: Please make yourself at home while I prepare the tickets.

entries.term: impress (v) · make an impression on sb · give sb an impression · do an impression of sb
entries.spoken: impress , make an impression on somebody , give somebody an impression , do an impression of somebody
entries.meaning: gây ấn tượng · gây ấn tượng với ai · tạo cho ai một cảm tưởng · nhại/bắt chước ai
entries.definition: Impress means cause admiration; make or give an impression describes the effect created, while do an impression of somebody means imitate them.
entries.note: make an impression on = gây ấn tượng; do an impression of sb = nhại/bắt chước ai.
entries.example: Her performance impressed the audience and made a lasting impression, while the comedian did an impression of a famous actor.

entries.meaning: xếp hàng · hàng người hoặc hàng xe đang chờ
entries.definition: To wait in a line for a service; queue is also the line itself.
entries.example: Hundreds of fans queued outside the venue, and the queue stretched around the building.

entries.meaning: có khả năng cao sẽ làm gì…
entries.definition: Certain or very likely to do something.
entries.note: be bound to V diễn tả khả năng gần như chắc chắn, mạnh hơn may/might.
entries.example: The sequel is bound to attract attention because the first film was internationally successful.

entries.term: vary (v) · a variety of ~ many · variable (a) · invariably (adv)
entries.spoken: vary , a variety of , many , variable , invariably
entries.type: verb · adjective · adverb · phrase / pattern · word family
entries.meaning: thay đổi/khác nhau · nhiều/đa dạng · hay thay đổi · luôn luôn
entries.definition: To change or differ; variety means many types; variable means changeable; invariably means always.
entries.note: variable = hay thay đổi; invariably = luôn luôn/không thay đổi. Hai từ cùng gốc nhưng nghĩa đối lập trong ngữ cảnh.
entries.example: Ticket prices vary, and a variety of discounts is available, but demand is invariably high.

entries.meaning: ngủ gật
entries.definition: To begin sleeping, often unintentionally.
entries.example: I dropped off during the slow opening scene but woke before the ending.

entries.meaning: xuất hiện # khoe khoang/phô trương
entries.definition: Show up means appear; show off means try to attract admiration.
entries.note: show up = xuất hiện; show off = khoe khoang/phô trương.
entries.example: The guest failed to show up, while another performer kept showing off on stage.

entries.meaning: giống về ngoại hình; tính cách (với ai đó trong gia đình)
entries.definition: To resemble an older family member in appearance or character.
entries.note: take after thường dùng với người trong gia đình; resemble không cần giới từ và dùng rộng hơn.
entries.example: She takes after her mother in appearance but resembles her father in personality.

entries.meaning: - cất cánh - trở nên nổi tiếng/thành công…
entries.definition: To leave the ground in an aircraft, or to suddenly become successful or popular.
entries.note: take off có thể là cất cánh, cởi đồ hoặc đột ngột thành công; ngữ cảnh quyết định.
entries.example: The series took off online shortly after the first episode was released.

entries.meaning: vải/chất liệu vải # quần áo
entries.definition: Cloth is material or a piece of fabric; clothes and clothing are things people wear.
entries.note: cloth là mảnh/chất liệu vải; clothes là quần áo; clothing là danh từ không đếm được chỉ quần áo nói chung.
entries.example: The designer cut a cloth sample before choosing clothing for the new collection.

entries.meaning: sản xuất
entries.definition: To produce goods in large quantities, usually in a factory.
entries.example: The company manufactures sportswear in factories that meet international safety standards.

entries.meaning: chủ động nhìn nhanh/cái nhìn nhanh ~ thoáng thấy/cái nhìn thoáng qua
entries.definition: A glance is a deliberate quick look; a glimpse is a brief, often accidental view.
entries.note: glance là chủ động nhìn nhanh; glimpse là thoáng thấy, thường không chủ ý.
entries.example: She glanced deliberately at the sketch but only glimpsed the final design through the doorway.

entries.meaning: có xu hướng làm gì · xu hướng/khuynh hướng
entries.definition: To usually act in a particular way; tendency is the related noun.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: tend to V · tendency (n).
entries.example: Fashion trends tend to return, and this tendency influences how brands plan collections.

entries.term: set an example · follow one's example
entries.spoken: set an example , follow one's example
entries.meaning: làm gương · noi theo gương ai
entries.definition: To behave as a model for others, or to copy another person's good behaviour.
entries.example: The designer set an example by using recycled materials, and younger brands followed her example.

entries.meaning: tác phẩm nghệ thuật
entries.definition: A piece of visual art; a work of art can also be any exceptionally creative object.
entries.note: artwork có thể đếm được/không đếm được tùy nghĩa; a work of art là một tác phẩm cụ thể.
entries.example: The gallery displays digital artwork beside a traditional work of art.

entries.term: compliment (v,n) # complement (v) · pay sb a compliment ~ pay a compliment to sb · compliment (v) sb on st
entries.spoken: compliment , complement , pay somebody a compliment , pay a compliment to somebody , compliment somebody on something
entries.type: verb · noun · phrase / pattern · word family
entries.meaning: khen/lời khen # bổ sung/làm hoàn chỉnh · dành cho ai một lời khen · khen ai về điều gì
entries.definition: Compliment means praise somebody or give praise; complement means add something that makes another thing complete or better.
entries.note: compliment sb on st; pay sb a compliment. Đừng nhầm compliment với complement = bổ sung, làm hoàn chỉnh.
entries.example: The reviewer complimented the designer on colours that complemented the shape of the dress.

entries.meaning: nhìn chằm chằm
entries.definition: To look continuously and directly at somebody or something.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: stare (v) at sb/st.
entries.example: Visitors stared at the unusual dress because its structure challenged familiar ideas.

entries.term: insist (v) on st · insist (v) that S + V
entries.spoken: insist on something , insist that S + verb
entries.meaning: khăng khăng đòi/yêu cầu điều gì · nhất quyết khẳng định rằng
entries.definition: To demand something firmly or repeatedly, or to state strongly that something is true.
entries.note: insist on + noun/V-ing; insist that + clause. Trong tiếng Anh-Mỹ trang trọng, động từ sau that thường ở nguyên mẫu.
entries.example: The client insisted on a simpler design and insisted that the final material be recyclable.

entries.meaning: làm ai hào hứng/nói đầy hào hứng · nhiệt tình/hào hứng · sự nhiệt tình/hào hứng · người đam mê
entries.definition: To make somebody enthusiastic or to speak with enthusiasm; enthusiastic, enthusiasm, and enthusiast are related forms.
entries.note: enthuse somebody là làm ai hào hứng; enthuse about/over something là nói đầy hào hứng; enthusiastic là tính từ, enthusiasm là cảm xúc, enthusiast là người đam mê
entries.example: The exhibition enthused young designers, whose enthusiasm attracted many fashion enthusiasts.

entries.meaning: sự kì vọng/mong đợi # sự dự tính (thường gặp trong life expectancy: tuổi thọ dự tính)
entries.definition: Expectation is a belief about what will happen; expectancy is mainly used in fixed ideas such as life expectancy.
entries.note: expectation là kì vọng; expectancy thường xuất hiện trong life expectancy = tuổi thọ dự tính.
entries.example: Customer expectations change quickly, while life expectancy refers to the expected length of life.

entries.term: do away with ~ get rid of
entries.spoken: do away with , get rid of
entries.meaning: vứt bỏ; loại bỏ
entries.definition: To remove, abolish, or stop using something.
entries.example: The brand plans to do away with plastic packaging and get rid of unnecessary labels.

entries.meaning: tạo ra (một kế hoạch; lịch trình; danh sách…)
entries.definition: To prepare and write a plan, list, agreement, or other formal document.
entries.example: The team drew up a production plan and a list of approved materials.

entries.term: grow out of st ~ outgrow st
entries.spoken: grow out of something , outgrow something
entries.meaning: lớn quá không phù hợp với … (quần áo; đồ chơi…)
entries.definition: To become too old or large for clothes, habits, toys, or interests.
entries.note: grow out of/outgrow dùng khi người lớn quá hoặc phát triển vượt khỏi quần áo, thói quen hay sở thích.
entries.example: Children quickly grow out of clothes and may outgrow toys at the same time.

entries.meaning: mòn/hỏng hoặc làm kiệt sức # mất dần tác dụng/cảm giác
entries.definition: Wear out means become unusable through use; wear off means gradually lose effect.
entries.note: wear out = mòn/hỏng hoặc làm kiệt sức; wear off = tác dụng/cảm giác giảm dần.
entries.example: Repeated use wore the fabric out, while the protective coating gradually wore off.

entries.meaning: làm cho tăng/nâng lên ~ tự tăng/sự tăng lên
entries.definition: Raise is transitive and makes something increase; rise is intransitive and means to increase by itself.
entries.note: raise là ngoại động từ cần tân ngữ; rise là nội động từ, không có tân ngữ trực tiếp.
entries.example: The company raised salaries after profits rose for the third consecutive year.

entries.term: fire sb ~ sack sb ~ dismiss sb ~ lay sb off ~ make sb redundant
entries.spoken: fire somebody , sack somebody , dismiss somebody , lay somebody off , make somebody redundant
entries.ipa: fire /ˈfaɪɚ/ · sack /sæk/ · dismiss /dɪˈsmɪs/ · lay /leɪ/ · off /ɔːf/ · make /meɪk/ · redundant /rɪˈdʌndənt/
entries.meaning: sa thải; đuổi việc
entries.definition: To end somebody's employment; lay off and make redundant often relate to business needs rather than misconduct.
entries.note: fire/sack/dismiss thường do lỗi hoặc quyết định cá nhân; lay off/make redundant thường do cắt giảm vị trí, không nhất thiết vì lỗi.
entries.example: The firm dismissed one manager for misconduct but laid several workers off because demand fell.

entries.meaning: công ty, tập đoàn
entries.definition: A business company, especially one providing professional services.
entries.example: The consulting firm advises small businesses on finance, staffing, and long-term strategy.

entries.term: complain (v) to sb about st · make a complaint to sb about st
entries.spoken: complain to somebody about something , make a complaint to somebody about something
entries.meaning: phàn nàn với ai về việc gì · gửi/nêu lời phàn nàn với ai về việc gì
entries.definition: To express dissatisfaction to somebody about a problem; complaint is the related noun.
entries.note: complain to sb about st; make a complaint to sb about st. Giữ đủ người nhận và vấn đề.
entries.example: Customers complained to the manager about the delay and later made a formal complaint.

entries.meaning: đang trực/đang làm nhiệm vụ >< hết ca/không làm nhiệm vụ
entries.definition: On duty means officially working; off duty means not currently working.
entries.example: The nurse was on duty during the emergency, while the senior doctor was off duty.

entries.term: make an effort to do st ~ make an attempt to do st · put effort into doing st
entries.spoken: make an effort to do something , make an attempt to do something , put effort into doing something
entries.meaning: nỗ lực làm gì · bỏ công sức vào việc gì
entries.definition: To try hard to achieve something; put effort into is followed by an -ing form.
entries.note: make an effort/attempt + to V; put effort into + V-ing.
entries.example: The team made an effort to reduce waste and put considerable effort into improving safety.

entries.meaning: tiền lãi ngân hàng
entries.definition: Money earned on savings or paid for borrowing money.
entries.note: interest là tiền lãi; interest rate là lãi suất
entries.example: The bank paid interest on her savings, while borrowers paid interest on their loans.

entries.term: attach (v) A to B · be attached to sb/st
entries.spoken: attach A to B , be attached to somebody or something
entries.meaning: gắn/đính một vật vào vật khác · được gắn vào/gắn bó với ai hoặc điều gì
entries.definition: To fasten, connect, or include A with B; attached to can also describe emotional closeness.
entries.note: attach A to B là gắn/đính kèm; be attached to còn có thể nghĩa là gắn bó về tình cảm.
entries.example: Please attach the document to the email; long-term employees may also feel attached to the firm.

entries.term: specialize (v) in st ~ major (v) in st · major (n)
entries.spoken: specialize in something , major in something , major
entries.type: verb · noun · phrase / pattern · word family
entries.meaning: chuyên sâu/chuyên môn về điều gì ~ học chuyên ngành nào · chuyên ngành chính
entries.definition: To focus professionally or academically on one subject; a major is the main university subject.
entries.note: specialize in dùng cho chuyên môn nghề nghiệp; major in dùng cho chuyên ngành học ở đại học.
entries.example: She specializes in international trade and majored in economics at university.

entries.meaning: thương mại/buôn bán · thuộc thương mại/nhằm lợi nhuận · quảng cáo
entries.definition: The activity of buying and selling; commercial means related to business and can also mean an advertisement.
entries.note: commerce/trade là thương mại; commercial (a) là thuộc thương mại, a commercial (n) là quảng cáo.
entries.example: Electronic commerce supports global trade, while a commercial can advertise a product.

entries.term: dedicate A to B ~ devote A to B ~ commit A to B · dedication (n) ~ devotion (n) ~ commitment (n)
entries.spoken: dedicate A to B , devote A to B , commit A to B , dedication , devotion , commitment
entries.ipa: dedicate /ˈdɛdəˌkeɪt/ · devote /dɪˈvoʊt/ · commit /kəˈmɪt/ · dedication /ˌdɛdəˈkeɪʃən/ · devotion /dɪˈvoʊʃən/ · commitment /kəˈmɪtmənt/
entries.meaning: dành/cống hiến một điều cho ai hoặc mục đích nào đó · sự tận tâm/cống hiến/cam kết
entries.definition: To give time, effort, or resources seriously to a purpose; the nouns describe devotion or commitment.
entries.note: dedicate/devote A to B gần nghĩa; commit nhấn mạnh cam kết lâu dài hoặc nguồn lực/trách nhiệm.
entries.example: The researcher devoted her career to public health and showed remarkable dedication to the project.

entries.meaning: chăm chỉ/cần cù # thuộc công nghiệp · ngành công nghiệp
entries.definition: Industrious, hard-working, and diligent describe a person who works carefully; industrial relates to industry or manufacturing.
entries.note: industrious = chăm chỉ; industrial = thuộc công nghiệp. Cùng gốc nhưng không cùng nghĩa.
entries.example: The industrious employee works diligently, while industrial policy concerns manufacturing and the wider industry.

entries.meaning: giám sát · sự giám sát · người giám sát
entries.definition: To direct and check another person's work; supervision is the process and supervisor is the person.
entries.example: A supervisor supervised the training, and every task was completed under close supervision.

entries.meaning: đưa hoặc ra mắt một sản phẩm mới
entries.definition: To launch or introduce a new product to the public.
entries.example: The company will bring out a cheaper version of the product next month.

entries.term: see to st ~ deal with st
entries.spoken: see to something , deal with something
entries.meaning: xử lí, lo liệu
entries.definition: To deal with a task, problem, or person's needs.
entries.note: Giữ đúng mẫu từ đi kèm: see to st ~ deal with st.
entries.example: I will see to the complaint today and deal with the payment error personally.

entries.term: stand in for sb # stand for
entries.spoken: stand in for somebody , stand for
entries.meaning: thay tạm ai # viết tắt/đại diện cho
entries.definition: Stand in for means temporarily replace somebody; stand for means represent or mean.
entries.note: stand in for sb = thay tạm ai; stand for = viết tắt hoặc đại diện cho.
entries.example: Mina stood in for the absent manager; the initials HR stand for Human Resources.

entries.term: take on sb · take on a job/responsibility/duty
entries.spoken: take on somebody , take on a job or responsibility or duty
entries.meaning: tuyển dụng ai · nhận/đảm nhiệm công việc, trách nhiệm hoặc nhiệm vụ
entries.definition: Take on somebody means employ them; take on work means accept responsibility for it.
entries.note: take on sb = tuyển người; take on a task/responsibility = nhận đảm nhiệm.
entries.example: The firm took on two graduates, and each new employee took on a specific responsibility.

entries.meaning: từ chối (lời mời…)
entries.definition: To say no to or not accept an offer, request, invitation, or proposal.
entries.note: turn down thường dùng với lời mời/đề nghị; reject trang trọng và dứt khoát hơn; decline lịch sự/trang trọng.
entries.example: She turned down the offer politely, while the committee rejected the revised proposal.
